And therefore one does not bless over a fragrance that has no substance — for it is impossible to receive the light of the intellect except through the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of contraction — from which is the root of all things from which a person receives his life-force.

segments.he: ומאחר שנתעברה וילדה מובן שהיא מצד בחי' הקדושה שהוא בחי' חיים נצחיים בחי' קיום העולם במין ובבחי' שארז"ל לענין האדם שמניח בן וכו' כאלו לא מת. ועל כן אמר וחלב טהור סותם את הנקב. כי הוא כגופו של בשר עצמו וע"כ גם בטבעו הואאדוק בו היטב וסותם. משא"כ חלב טמא מאחר שהוא מבחי' הלובן דסט"א כנ"ל ע"כאינו אדוק כל כך בבשר ואינו סותם. ועל כן כל שכנגדו בבהמה טמא גם בחיה אינו סותם כי די לו להפקיע את עצמו במה שהתירתו תורה מחמת שהוא ממין חיה כנ"ל אבל לא לסתום ולהציל הבעל חי מטרפות על ידו כי הוא ג"כ אינו אדוק בטבעו בבשר ואעפ"כ הכשירתו תורה כנ"ל:
segments.en:
סִימָן טו — אִיסּוּר עֲרָיוֹת דְּאוֹרַיְיתָא וְדְרַבָּנָן

[§1]
Forbidden relations by Torah law and by rabbinic law — etc. For holy Torah gauged with its holy wisdom: that these unions cannot be in the aspect of holy union and connection — the aspect of drawing these rectifications mentioned. And in addition to what the Torah forbade — the Sages added further — and since the Sages already forbade them — they too are in the aspect mentioned.

segments.he: סימן ס"א
segments.en: [§2] But since in holiness every aspect and attribute is comprised of all the others — the Tefillin too are comprised of both aspects: the ches and the nun. The hand-Tefillin [shel yad] is the aspect of the mochin d'nukva [feminine consciousness] — the aspect of nun — and the head-Tefillin [shel rosh] is the aspect of the light of intellect — the ches. And therefore each contains four portions [parshiyos] corresponding to the aspect of the nun — which is poor and destitute — and together they are eight portions — corresponding to the aspect of the ches. And therefore the hand-Tefillin precedes the head-Tefillin — for first one must rectify the contraction, and then one merits to receive the mochin.

segments.he: וע,כ צריך ליתן לכהן זרוע ולחיים וקיבה של שור ושה וכו' ומבואר בליקוטי תורה להאריז"ל פ' שופטים כי לחיים הם כנגד ג' ראשונות וזרוע כנגד חג"ת וקיבה כנגד נה"י שש םמקומה נמצא שמרמזין לכלליות בחינת המשכת התיקונים הנ"ל.ף וע"כ נותנין לכהן. כי בכהונה יש גם כן בחי' כלליות כולם (עיין מאורי אור) וע"כ עי"ז נגמר התיקון של אכילת הבשר בשלימות. ועל כן חיה ועוף שאין בהם אחיזת הסט"א כ"כ כנ"ל ע"כ אין צריכין לתיקון זה. ועל כן החיוב על השוחט ליתן המתנות לכהן כי הוא העוסק בהתיקון של הבהמה שע"י השחיטה. היינו להמתיק הדינין בשרשן לבטל ממנה אחיזת הכסילות והסט"א ע"כ צריך לגמור התיקון על ידי המתנות להכהן איש החסד והוא בבחי' כי שפתי כהן ישמרו דעת ותורה יבקשו מפיהו. (עיין עסעיף כ"ח):
segments.en: [§1] And therefore one must give the kohen the foreleg and the cheeks and the maw of the ox and the sheep — etc. — and it is explained in Likutay Torah of the Ari, Parshas Shoftim: the cheeks correspond to the three first [ Keter, Chochmah, Binah ] — and the foreleg corresponds to ChagaT — and the maw corresponds to NHY — where it rests. It emerges that they allude to the totality of the aspect of drawing these rectifications. And therefore they are given to the kohen — for in the priesthood there is also the aspect of the totality of all of them — (see Maurai Or ) — and through this the rectification of the eating of meat is completed in its fullness. And therefore the chayah and fowl — in which the hold of the sitra achra is not as strong — as stated — do not require this rectification. And therefore the obligation is upon the slaughterer to give these gifts to the kohen — for he is the one engaged in the rectification of the animal through the shechitah — to sweeten the judgments at their root — to nullify from it the hold of foolishness and the sitra achra . And therefore he must complete the rectification through the gifts to the kohen — the man of kindness — and this is the aspect of: "for the kohen's lips shall guard knowledge — and Torah shall be sought from his mouth" [Malachi 2:7]. (See section 28.) Siman 62 — Ever min HaChai : A Limb from a Living Animal סִימָן ס״ב [§1] And therefore it is forbidden to eat a limb from a living animal — and flesh that separates from a living animal. For as long as the judgments have not been sweetened at their root through the rectifications of shechitah — it is impossible to separate the evil and foolishness that has seized the spirit of the creature — which is the hold of the spirit of folly — the stormy spirit from the sitra achra of Esav. And therefore such eating greatly damages the soul. And also: because it is an extreme act of cruelty — which is from the quality of wild and impure animals — that tear and eat while alive — and these animals are the very opposite of the aspects of holy Chochmah and holy life-force — from which is the root of mercy and kindness and the nullification of all types of anger and rage and cruelty — as stated many times. Siman 63 — Meat That Was Out of Sight סִימָן ס״ג [§1] And since the essential strengthening of the sitra achra in eating is in the eating of meat — as stated — one must guard it: and meat that was out of sight is forbidden unless according to the circumstances explained in the Shulchan Aruch — since we fear that perhaps it was exchanged through the aspect of the transpositions and substitutions of the sitra achra — and its palaces of transposition — which provoke to exchange and substitute — etc. — as is known. Siman 64, 65 and on — Fat, Blood, and the Thigh-Sinew סִימָן ס״ד, ס״ה וְכוּ׳ [§1] The matter of the prohibition of fat and blood is somewhat explained above. And likewise the thigh-sinew is forbidden — because Yaakov our father was pained in it when he wrestled with the guardian-prince of Esav — which is the aspect of the yetzer hara . And this sinew corresponds to Tisha b'Av — on which our holy Temple was destroyed — which encompasses all these rectifications — as explained in the section of Orach Chaim. Siman 69 and on — Washing and Salting Meat סִימָן ס״ט וְכוּ׳ [§1] And therefore meat requires washing and salting — in order to wash away the visible blood upon it — which is forbidden as stated — and also to soften the meat so that the salt can extract the blood from it. For even though the meat has already been purified from the visible blood upon it — even so one must extract from it also the seeping blood [ dam pelitah ] — for even though the blood of the organs that has not seeped out is permitted — for this is the aspect of: *"He has not looked upon iniquity in Yaakov"* — and our Sages taught: evil thought — Hashem does not join it to action — for since it has not seeped out to bring the evil into actual deed — G-d forbid — in actual action — one is not punished for this since one prevailed over one's inclination in deed at least. Even so: one must purify the heart also from such thoughts — G-d forbid — and subdue also the evil within it that is only in potential — not in actual deed. For otherwise — G-d forbid — it is easy for the yetzer hara to prevail over one even in actual deed — G-d forbid. And this is the aspect of what one must salt the meat — so that it also expels the blood absorbed in the organs — for at the beginning of cooking — certainly the blood within it will seep and move from place to place and will forbid. And therefore salting is required — and the salt — through its pungency and saltiness — extracts even the blood absorbed in the organs.

segments.he: סימן ס"ב
segments.en: [§3] And our Sages taught: "All the time that they are between your eyes, there shall be two" — meaning it is forbidden to remove the hand-Tefillin before the head-Tefillin — for the head-Tefillin alludes to the aspect of the ches. And therefore one must have Tefillin on during the recitation of Shema — which comprises the acceptance of the yoke of Heavenly Kingship [the aspect of nun] and the yoke of Torah and mitzvos through which one gives strength to holy Malchus — and during the Tefillah [Amidah prayer] — for through this all prayers and requests are accepted — as stated.

segments.he: וע"כ אסור לאכול אבר מן החי ובשר הפורש מן החי. כי כל זמן שלא נמתקו הדינים בשרשם ע,י תיקוני השחיטה א"א להפריד הרע והכסילות הנאחז ברוח הבעל חי שהוא אחיזת הרוח שטות רוח סערה מסטרא דעשו. וע"כ אכילה כזו פוגמת הנפש מאד. וגם כי הוא ממדת אכזריות מאד שהוא ממדת החיות רעות וטמאות הדורסים ואוכלים וטורפים ואוכלים ואלו החיות הם ההיפוך מבחינת החכמה והחיות דקדושה שמשם שורש הרחמים והחסדים וביטול כל מיני רוגז וכעס ואכזריות כנ"ל כמה פעמים:
segments.en:
סִימָן טז

[§1]
The prohibition of a non-Jewish woman or a slave woman. For it is a union of the sitra achra literally — to the point that even the son born from this is not called his son — but her son. And his punishment is very severe — as our Sages taught.

segments.he: סימן ס"ג
segments.en: [§4] It is forbidden to interrupt between the hand-Tefillin and the head-Tefillin. Our Sages taught: "One who spoke between the hand-Tefillin and the head-Tefillin must return to battle" [Sotah 44b]. For one must bind and unify the ches and the nun so they are in a single unity — in a complete union [yichuda shlim] — and through this one merits to overpower and conquer the battle and fully subdue the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — as is explained within [the discourse].

segments.he: ומחמת שעיקר התגברות הסט"א באכילה הוא באיכלת בשר כנ"ל ע,כ צריך לשמרו ובשר שנתעלם מן העין אסור אם לא על פי האופנים המבואר יםבשו"ע דחיישינן שמא הוחלף ע"י בחי' התמורות והחלופין של בחי' הסט"א והיכלי התמורות שמתגרין להחליף ולהמיר וכו' כידוע:
segments.en: And his punishment is very severe — as our Sages taught.

segments.he: סימן ס"ד ס"ה וכו'
segments.en: [§5] The black color of the Tefillin and straps — for black alludes to the aspect of tzimtzum [contraction], as is known. And therefore even the ink with which the portions of the Tefillin are written — which are the aspect of the light of the holy mochin — must specifically be black.

segments.he: ענין איסור חלב ודם מבואר קצת לעיל. וכן גיד הנשה אסור לפי שנצטער בו יעקב אבינו בהאבקו עם שרו של עשו שהוא בחינת היצה"ר וגיד זה הוא כנגד ט' באב שבו נחרב בית מקדשינו שכלול מכל התיקונים הנ"ל כמבואר בחלק אורח חיים:
segments.en: And his punishment is very severe — as our Sages taught.

segments.he: סימן ס"ט וכו'
segments.en: [§6] The square shape of the Tefillin alludes to the aspect of Dalet mentioned above. The tittura [the base of the Tefillin box, which covers the opening of the compartment] — this is to cover and conceal the light of the holy mochin — in the aspect of *"the glory of G-d is to conceal a matter"* [Mishlei 25:2]. And this is also the aspect of the Name Shakai [שַׁדַּי] in the Tefillin, which also alludes to the aspect of the mochin and the contraction — as is explained in the discourse Tiku Emunah, Likutay Torah [Part II], Siman 5.

segments.he: וע,כ צריך הבשר הדחה ומליחה בכדי להדיח הדם בעין שעליו שהוא אסור כנ"ל וגם כדי לרכך הבשר שיוכל המלח להפליט הדם ממנו. כי אף שכבר נטהר הבשר מהדם בעין שעליו אעפ"כ צריכין להוציא ממנו גם דם פליטה כי אע"פ שד םהאיברים שלא פירש מותר כי זה בחי' לא הביט און ביעקב וכו' ודרז"ל מחשבה רעה אין הקב"ה מצרפה למעשה כי מאחר שלא פירש להוציא הרעה אל הפועל ח"ו במעשה ממש אין נענש על זה מאחר שהתגבר על יצרו במעשה עכ"פ. אף על פי כן צריכןי לטהר הלב גם מימשבות כאלו ח"ו ולהכניע גם הרע שיש בו בכח ולא בפועל ממש. כי באם לאו בנקל ח"ו שיתגבר עליו יצרו גם בפועל ממש ח"ו שזה בחינת מה שצריכין למלוח הבשר בכדי שיפלוט גם הדם הבלוע באיברים כי בשעת התחלת הבישול בוודאי יפרוש ויצא הדם שבו ממקום למקום ויאסור. וע"כ צריך מליחה והמלח ע"י החריפות והמליחות שבי מוציא ממנו גם הדם הנבלע באיברים, וכמו כן לעובדא לענין האדם. המלחיה היא בבחי' מה שארז"ל לעולם ירגיז אדם יצ"ט על יצה"ר היינו שלא ימתין עד שעה שיראה שיצרו רוצה להתגבר עלי וולהביאו אל החטא בפועל ממש ואז יחגור כלי מלחמתו להלחם בו. כי אם כשיצרו עדיין בכח ולא בפועל עדיין אז ירגיז עליו יצרו הטוב ויתגרה בו במלחמה בכדי לגרשו ממנו לגמרי שלא ישלוט בו גם בבחינת כח לבד. וזה שנאמר רגזו ואז בוודאי ואל תחטאו וכו'. וכן מה שלומד תורה בכח ויגיעה ומקבל ע"ע יסורים ומרירות בשביל עול תורה וכשארז"ל אין התורה מתקיימ' אלא במי שממית עצמו עליה. זה ג,כ בחינת תיקון הבשר שע"י מליחה הנ"ל. כמובן במאמר ויאמר בועז סי' ס"ה. (ועיין זוה"ק ויחי דף רמ"א בענין המתקת הדינים שבבחינת מלכות שהיא ע"י בחי' מלח ומזה מובן ג,כ ענין המליחה הנ"ל) ואז אחר המליחה צריכין לחזור ולהדיח הבשר ולנקות אותו מהמלח ומדם זה שנפלט ממנו ואז הותר הבשר לאכילה כי שוב אין בו כלל מאחיזת עשו איש הדמים אפילו רק בבחי' כח לבד כנ"ל: וע,כ בשר ששהה ג' ימים בלא הדחה ומליחה שוב לא מהני לו מליחה כי נתייבש דמו בתוכו והוא כעין שדרז"ל (בבא קמא דף פ"ב) וילכו שלשת ימים במדבר ולא מצאו מים וכו' כיון שהלכו שלשת ימים בלא תורה נלאו עמדו נביאים שביניהם ותקנו וכו' כדי שלא ילינו ג' ימים בלא תורה. וכבר מבואר כי תיקון הבשר ע"י הדחה ומליחה הוא בבחינת הכנעת היצר הרע בחינת עשו שעיקר הכנעתו ע"י מימי התורה והחכמה כנ"ל וע"כ אם שהה ג' ימים וכו' שזה בחי' שנפרד מהתורה בבחי' שלשת ימים הנ"ל אזי בוודאי כבר נתקשה ונתייבש הדם שבתוכו עד שכבר קשה להוציאו ולהפליטו גם ע"י הדחה ומליחה ולכן אין לאכלו אלא צלי ומאחר שצלאו אעפ"כ לא יבשלנו לכתחלה כמבואר בשו"ע. וע"כ אם נשרה במים תוך הג' ימים מותר להשהותו עד קרוב לג' ימים אחרים: והנה מענין זה מובן קצת מה שלפעמים שדייקא אז מתגרה בו יצרו ביותר בבלבולים ומחשבות וכו' מה שלא עלו על דעתו מקודם וזה כמו בחי' תקון המליחה שמתחלה בפרט לאחר הדחה אז הבשר נקי ואינו נראה עליו שום לחלוחית דמים ואח"כ ע"י המליחה דייקא נתמלא הבשר מציר ודם שנפלט ממנו כי בתחלה היה הדם נבלע באיברים ועכשיו יצא ונפלט ע"י המליחה וע,כ נתלכלך הבשר עוד הפעם עד שידיחו אותו שנית ואז יהיה נקי באמת מכל מיני דמים הן בחוץ והן בפנים (וכעין מבואר גם בהשיחות) וע"כ צריכין ליזהר אז ביותר לבל יפול בלבו שום חלישו תהדעת ע,י בחי' ההתגרות שעכשיו ביותר. כי כך הענין כי זה בעצמו טהרתו ותיקונו כנ"ל אך אעפ"כ עכ"פ לא יהיה ניחא לו בזה ח"ו. רק יתגבר כנגד הבלבולים תיכף לגרשם בכל כחו ועכ"פ יברח מהם תיכף אל הקדושה ועכ"פ לא יהיה כמהרהר וחוזר ומהרהר ח"ו וכמבואר מזה במ"א וזה בחי' מה שצרייכן למלוח בכלי מנוקב דייקא בכדי שיהיה מקום לציר ודם הנפלט לזוב ולצאת משא"כ אם אין לו מקום לזוב אזי לא די שמה שנשרה בציר ודם נאסר כי חזר ונבלע בו הדם ולא מהני ליה שוב מליחה וצליה.
segments.en: [§1] And therefore meat requires washing and salting — in order to wash away the visible blood upon it — which is forbidden as stated — and also to soften the meat so that the salt can extract the blood from it. For even though the meat has already been purified from the visible blood upon it — even so one must extract from it also the seeping blood [ dam pelitah ] — for even though the blood of the organs that has not seeped out is permitted — for this is the aspect of: *"He has not looked upon iniquity in Yaakov"* — and our Sages taught: evil thought — Hashem does not join it to action — for since it has not seeped out to bring the evil into actual deed — G-d forbid — in actual action — one is not punished for this since one prevailed over one's inclination in deed at least. Even so: one must purify the heart also from such thoughts — G-d forbid — and subdue also the evil within it that is only in potential — not in actual deed. For otherwise — G-d forbid — it is easy for the yetzer hara to prevail over one even in actual deed — G-d forbid. And this is the aspect of what one must salt the meat — so that it also expels the blood absorbed in the organs — for at the beginning of cooking — certainly the blood within it will seep and move from place to place and will forbid. And therefore salting is required — and the salt — through its pungency and saltiness — extracts even the blood absorbed in the organs. [§2] And likewise regarding the spiritual matter for the person: the salting is in the aspect of what our Sages taught: "let a person always arouse his yetzer tov against his yetzer hara " — meaning: one should not wait until the moment one sees one's inclination wanting to overpower and bring one to sin in actual deed — and only then gird one's battle weapons to fight it. But rather: while one's inclination is still only in potential — not yet in actual deed — at that point one arouses one's yetzer tov — and provokes it — and initiates battle against it — in order to drive it away entirely — so that it does not rule over one even only in the aspect of potential. And this is what is said: "tremble" — and certainly then: "and do not sin" — etc. [§3] And likewise: one who studies Torah with force and effort — and accepts upon himself suffering and bitterness for the sake of the yoke of Torah — as our Sages taught: "Torah only endures in one who kills himself over it." This too is the aspect of the rectification of the meat through salting as stated — as understood in the discourse Vayomar Boaz , Siman 65. (And see the holy Zohar, Vayechi 241 — regarding the sweetening of the judgments in the aspect of Malchus — which is through the aspect of salt — and from this the matter of salting is also understood.) And then after salting — one must go back and wash the meat and clean it of the salt — and of this blood that was expelled from it. And then the meat is permitted for eating — for there is no longer any hold of Esav the man of blood — even only in the aspect of potential. [§4] And therefore: meat that sat three days without washing and salting — salting no longer helps it — for its blood has dried within it. And this is like what our Sages taught [Bava Kamma 82]: "and they walked three days in the wilderness and found no water" — etc. — since they walked three days without Torah — they grew tired. And our Sages standing among them arose and ordained — etc. — so that they not rest three days without Torah. And it is already explained: the rectification of meat through washing and salting is the aspect of subduing the yetzer hara — the aspect of Esav — whose essential subduing is through the waters of Torah and wisdom. And therefore: if it sat three days — etc. — the aspect of having been separated from Torah in the three days mentioned — then certainly the blood within it has already hardened and dried — to the point that it is already difficult to extract and expel it — even through washing and salting. And therefore one may not eat it except roasted — and since one has roasted it — even so one should not cook it initially — as explained in the Shulchan Aruch . And therefore: if it was soaked in water within the three days — one is permitted to keep it until close to another three days.

segments.he: אלא אפילו כל החתיכה שחוץ לציר נאסרה ג"כ ואין לה שום תיקון כי הדם שבתוכה פירש ממקום למקום ולא יצא מאחר שלא היה לו מקום לזוב ולצאת וכמ וכן לעניניו מאחר שאינו מזדרז בזה לגרשו מכל מניי בלבולים ולכלוכים העולים על לבו עכשיו דייקא רק אדר בא נראה כאלו ח"ו ניחא לו בזה אז לא די שהם בעצמם נדבקים ונאחזים בלבו עד שקשה לו אח"כ לטהר עצמו מזה אף גם כל מוחו ולבו נתבלבלו ונטרפו עי"ז ביותר.
segments.en:
סִימָן י״ז

[§1]
And therefore: one who slaughters a critically ill animal — it is forbidden unless it convulsed. For since the sitra d'mosa — the aspect of neveilah [an unslaughtered carcass] — has already been provoked upon it to the point of it becoming critically ill — certainly its life-force departed before the completion of the shechitah and it is actual neveilah — unless it convulsed at the completion of the shechitah — etc. — for then one sees that it still had life-force throughout the entire shechitah — and it was thereby rectified through the rectifications of shechitah like other cattle and fowl.

[§2]
And even so — the great ones of Israel would not eat from such an animal — for our Sages taught regarding one who does much — that the essential provocation of the yetzer hara is against the great. And therefore they are especially careful to distance themselves from any aspect or semblance that resembles even slightly the aspect of the sitra d'mosa — the aspect of neveilah. And this is what the precise language says: the great sages — specifically — meaning those who are completely bound to the aspect of holy intellect and Chochmah. And this is what our Sages taught [Chullin 37] — in the matter of what Yechezkel said: "behold my soul has not been made impure" — meaning that he prevailed over the yetzer hara — that he did not think [be aroused] by day — and not to damage through it even in bare thought — which is the aspect of Chochmah: mocha — ihu machashavah [the brain — that is thought]. And: "and carrion and torn flesh I have not eaten" — that he did not eat doubtful meat [kos kos — critically ill animals] — etc. — meaning: since the essential hold of the yetzer hara — the aspect of Esav — at first is in the matter of eating — as cited also in Orach Chaim — he was therefore careful in his eating that the sitra achra have no hold from him — even from permitted matters — such as critically ill animals — or where a sage permitted based only on his own reasoning.

[§3]
For since the permission is not explicit or received from his teachers — there is reason to fear that another may come and dispute his reasoning — and therefore he abstained from eating this — so that they have no hold in this eating. For eating is in the aspect of Malchus — as is known — and therefore he was careful from a fine damage in both aspects: the aspect of Chochmah and intellect — and the aspect of Malchus — which are the totality of these rectifications. And therefore Yechezkel made these arguments when Hashem said to him: "take yourself a brick" — etc. — "and engrave upon it a city — Yerushalayim" — etc. [Yechezkel 4:1] — specifically leveinah [brick] — to indicate that they damaged the aspect of the moon — which is the essential aspect of Yerushalayim — the aspect of Malchus. And He commanded him then to suffer greatly in the matter of the Shechinah — in the matter of eating — to atone for Israel. But when Hashem said to him: "and it shall be baked on human excrement in their sight" — then he cried out all the above: "behold my soul has not been defiled" — etc. — for our Sages taught in the Jerusalem Talmud [Berachos]: why does one distance oneself four amos from the excrement of an infant — because his thoughts are evil — for the inclination of man's heart is evil from his youth. And this is what our Sages hinted at also in the Babylonian Talmud [Sukkah 42] — that with a grown person it is more severe — as it is said: "Yosef added trouble — Yosef added pain" [Iyov 34:37] — it emerges that the essential foulness of human excrement — most of all — is because the yetzer hara seizes more upon his eating — through the damage of thought — which is the aspect of Chochmah.

[§4]
And therefore Yechezkel cried out: "behold I am careful in all of this in its fullness — both in the holiness of thought and in the holiness of eating — and why must I bake my bread on the excrement of a human being?" And then Hashem permitted him to bake his bread on cattle dung — etc. (And from this a person can understand and hear a great lesson for his soul — etc.)

segments.he: כי מאחר שעוסק בתורה ועבודה קצת שסגולתם להכניע היצה"ר ולטהר הלב מכל מיני פסולת אפילו ממה שהוא עדיין רק בכח לבד שזה בעצמו הוא הטועם והסיבה שנדמה לו שמתגרין בו וכרוכין אחריו עכשיו ביותר כנ"ל. ואם היה חזק בזה בדעתו ובכל פעם שעולה איזה בלבול על לבו יגרשנו תיכף ויתן לו מקום לזוב ולצאת ממנו ואח"כ היה עולה על לבו איזה בלבול אחר והיה מגרשו ג"כ וכן בכל פעם עד שהיה זוכה לטהרת הלב באמת בבחי' ותשליך במצולות ים כל חטאתם במקום אשר וכו' ולא יעלו על לב לעולם משא"כ אם כשבא לו איזה בלבול וכןו' אינו נותן לו תיכף מקום לצאת רק אוחז בו ומעמיק בו ושונה באולתו ח"ו אזי הוא כטובל ושרך בידו ח"ו.
segments.en: [§7] For since one engages in Torah and service somewhat — whose special quality is to subdue the yetzer hara and purify the heart from all dross — even from what is still only in potential — this itself is the cause and reason why it seems that they provoke and cling to one even more right now — as stated. And if one were strong in this frame of mind — and each time some confusion comes upon one's heart — one drives it away immediately and gives it a place to flow and exit from oneself — and afterwards some other confusion would come upon one's heart and one would also drive it away — and so each time — until one merited true purity of heart — in the aspect of: *"and You shall cast into the depths of the sea all their sins"* [Michah 7:19] — to a place where — etc. — "and they shall never rise to the heart again." But if when some confusion comes — etc. — one does not immediately give it place to exit — but grasps it and deepens it and repeats its foolishness — G-d forbid — then one is like one who immerses while holding an impurity in one's hand.

segments.he: וממילא מובן כי אף שבשר הנמלח בכל שאינו מנוקב נאסר לעולם ולא מהני ליה שום תיקון לדידן כנ"ל. אבל באדם בוודאי אין לך דבר שעחומד בפני התשובה ואם יתגבר מעכשיו באמת וינקוב לבו האבן ויעסוק בעבודת השם באמת בוודאי יתתקן הכל. וע,כ אם אין לו מלח יצלה הבשר באש כי גם כח האש ישאוב הדם הנפלט ממנו באופן שלא יצא ויפרוש עוד הדם הבלוע בו.
segments.en: [§8] And from this it is self-evident: even though meat salted in a non-perforated vessel is permanently forbidden — and no rectification helps it — according to us — as stated. But with a person — certainly there is nothing that stands before repentance — and if one now truly strengthens oneself — and pierces one's stony heart — and engages in the service of Hashem in truth — certainly everything will be rectified. And therefore: if one has no salt — one roasts the meat over fire — for the power of fire also draws out the seeping blood — such that the blood absorbed in it will not seep and spread further.

segments.he: ועל כן לענין דם פליטה אמרינן איידי דטריד למיפלט לא בלע וכן כבולעו כך פולטו. אבל לא לענין דם בעין וכן לענין שאר איסורים כגון ציר נבלה וטרפה כי בדם פליטה מאחר שקודם שנפלט לא היה בכלל איסור כי דם האיברי' שלא פירש מותר כנ"ל רק מחמת שחוששין שלא יפרוש אח"כ ע"כ עוסק בזה להוציאו ולהפליטו ע"כ לא חיישי' בו כל כך משא"כ דם בעין ושאר איסורין שכבר נאחז בהם הסט"א ביותר ע"כ צריכים להרחיק מהם ביותר ולא אמרינן בהם סברות הנ"ל: וע"כ הכבד מחמת שהוא מלא דם ובו עיקר אחיזת עשו אדמוני כמובן במאמר שאלו סימן נ"ז וזה בחי' ויצא אדום לקראתו בעם כבד ע"כ לא מהני מליחה לכבד רק צליה באש שזה בחינת והיה בית יעקב אש וכו' ובית עשו לקש וכו': וע"כ ארז"ל אין מחזיקין דם בבני מעטם כי ארז"ל בני מעים לאו בשר ואוכליהון לאו בר אינש וע"כ מאחר שאינם ראוים בשלימות למאכל אדם ע"כ אין נאחזין בהם הדמים כל כך אא"כ חזינן דאסמיק שמזה נראה שיש בהן מבחינת אחיזת עשו אדמוני: וע,כ צריכןי למלוח הבני מעים מצד החיצון ששם השומן דבוק כי השומן שלהם מוחזק בדם כי שם עיקר אחיזתו בבחי' וישמן ויבעט כנ"ל. ועל כן דם בעין שנפל על הצלי אמרינן אדרבא שהאש מבליעו. כי זה בחי' דמגרי יצה"ר בנפשיה כי אין האש של התורה והשכל דקדושה מכניע רק כח הסט"א והיצה"ר שבטבע האדם שעי"ז נעשה עמו ממילא מה שנעשה וכשהאדם מצער על זה ולוחם עמו בכח יצרו הטוב רק שקשה לו להתגבר עליו אזי ע"י עסק התורה שנמשלה לאש מתגבר עליו ומפליטו מקרבו ומגרשו ומרחיקו מעצמו. משא"כ אם הוא תובע וקורא את יצרו ומעוררו על עצמו ח"ו אזי יוכל להיות אדר בא שיתגבר עליו ביותךר דייקא וכעין שארז"ל לענין המלמד את בתו תורה כאלו מלמדה תפלות שנא' אני חכמה שכנתי ערמה וכו' עיי"ש:
segments.en: [§9] And therefore: regarding seeping blood [ dam pelitah ] — we say: since it is busy seeping it does not absorb — and likewise: as it absorbs so it expels . But not regarding visible blood — and likewise not regarding other prohibitions such as brine of neveilah and treifah . For with seeping blood — since before it seeped out it was not in the category of prohibition — for the blood of the organs that had not seeped was permitted — as stated — only since we are concerned that it will seep out afterwards — therefore one engages with it to extract and expel it — and therefore we are not as concerned about it. But regarding visible blood and other prohibitions — where the sitra achra has already seized them more strongly — one must keep far from them — and the arguments mentioned do not apply. [§10] And therefore: the liver — since it is full of blood — and in it is the essential hold of Esav the red one — as understood in the discourse Sha'alu , Siman 57 — and this is the aspect of: *"and Edom came out to meet him with a heavy people"* [Bamidbar 20:20] [ am kaved — which also means liver] — therefore salting does not help for the liver — only roasting over fire — the aspect of: *"and the house of Yaakov shall be fire"* [Ovadyah 1:18] — etc. — "and the house of Esav shall be stubble" — etc. [§11] And therefore our Sages taught: blood is not retained in intestinal walls — for our Sages taught: intestinal walls are not flesh — and those who eat them are not fully human beings. And therefore: since they are not fully suited as human food — the bloods do not seize in them as strongly — unless we see that they reddened — which indicates there is in them the aspect of the hold of Esav the red one. And therefore one must salt intestinal walls on the outside — where the fat adheres — for their fat is regarded as blood — since there is the essential hold of: "and Yeshurun grew fat and kicked" — as stated. And therefore: visible blood that fell on roasting meat — we say the opposite: the fire absorbs it. For this is the aspect of: "one who provokes the yetzer hara within oneself" — for the fire of Torah and holy intellect subdues only the power of the sitra achra and the yetzer hara that is by nature in a person — and through this what happens naturally happens to it. But when a person deliberately seeks out and calls his inclination and awakens it upon himself — G-d forbid — then it can happen that it overpowers him even more specifically — as our Sages taught regarding one who teaches his daughter Torah: it is as if he taught her frivolity — as it is said: "I wisdom dwell with cunning" [Mishlei 8:12] — etc. — see there. Siman 79 and on — Signs of Pure and Impure Animals סִימָן ע״ט וְכוּ׳ [§1] The signs of a pure animal and chayah are chewing the cud and having a split hoof . For our Sages taught: examine the teeth and you will forget the shoes [meaning: the signs indicate each other]. And behold: a person has thirty-two teeth — corresponding to the thirty-two paths of Chochmah — from which is the essential rectification of eating — as all of this is explained in the kavanos . And through them is the essential power of the feet — for "the end is embedded in the beginning." And the light of holy Chochmah and holy Torah illuminate a person from the aspect of his head to his feet — the aspect of: *"a lamp to my feet is Your word — and a light to my path"* [Tehillim 119:105] . And this is the aspect of: "the wisdom of the prudent — he understands his way" [Mishlei 14:8] — the aspect of: "and the path of the righteous is as the shining light" — as explained within. And see in the discourse of the Ari at the end of the Tikkunim — on the verse: "I have pondered my ways and I have returned my feet" — etc. And also: Malchus corresponds to the aspect of the feet — as is known. And this is the aspect of our Sages' teaching: it was found to illuminate his eyes and make him stand on his feet.

segments.he: סימן ע"ט וכו'
segments.en: [§7] The four portions of the hand-Tefillin are all in one compartment — for they correspond only to the mochin d'nukva. But the portions of the head-Tefillin, which allude to the greater mochin — and since their holy illumination is very great — must each be placed in a separate compartment, making four compartments corresponding to the aspect of Dalet mentioned above.

segments.he: סימני בהמה וחיה טהורה הם מעלת גרה ומפרסת פרסה. כי ארז,ל דוק בככי ותשכח בנגרי והנה באדם יש ל"ב שיניים כנגד בחי' ל"ב נתיבות החכמה שמשם עיקר תיקון האכילה כמבואר כל זה בכוונות ועל ידם עיקר כח הרגלין כי נעוץ סופן בתחלתן. ואור החכמה דקדושה ואור התורה הק' מאירין להאדם מבחי' ראשו והעד רגליו בבחי' נר לרגלי דברך ואור לנתיבתי. וזה בחי' חכמת ערום הבין דרכו בחי'ואורח צדיקים כאור נוגה המבפ"נ. ועיין בפ' האריחז"ל שבסוף התיקונים על פסוק חשבתי דרכי ואשובה רגלי וכו' וגם כי המלכות הוא כנגד בחי' הרגלן כידוע וזה בחי' מה שארז"ל נמצא מאירתו את עיניו ומעמידתו על רגליו. והנה זה לעומת זה המלכות דסט"א בחינת עשו כלול ג"כ משני הבחי' הנ"ל דקליפה וזה בחינת מה שנאמר (דניאל ז') לענין החיה הרביעית שינין די פרזל לה רברבין אכלה ומדקה ושארה ברגליה רפסה. ועל כן בבהמות וחות שנאחז בהם ביות זוהמת עשו ובחי' רוח שטות וכסילות היפוך החכמה דקדושה שהיא עיקר בחי' אדם כנ"ל ע"כ כשיש לה שיניים או ניבים עכ"פ גם בלחי העליון שאז ע"פ רוב אינה מעלת גרה כי מדקת ושוחקת המאכל בשיניה היטב עד שנתעכל בנקל בתוכה המאכל ואינו חוזר ועולה למעלה לתוך פיה ועל כן אינה מעלת גרה וגם אינה מפרסת פרסה שעי" יש לה חיזוק ביותר בפרסות רגליה על כן הם סימני טומאה כי זה מורה שנאחז בהרוח הטס"א ביותר שכרוך אחר הנאת האכילה ביותר ונדמה לו שיש לו מעמד חזק ושלם בזה העולם. אבל אם מעלת גרה שזה מחמת שאין לה שיניים בלחי העליון ואינה יכולה לדקדק ולשחוק מאכלה היטב על כן הוא חוזר ועולה בכל פעם למעלה לתוך פיה וגם פרסותיה סדוקות שעי"ז אין לה חיזוק כ"כ בפרסות רגליה מזה מובן שאין לרוח הבהמיות שבה תוקף וחיזוק גדול כל כך בפרט בענין אכילתה ששם עיקר אחיזת הבהמיות ושם עיקר אחיזת עשו כנ"ל. וע, כ אם רואין בה סימנים אלו משיניה ועד פרסות רגליה מזה נודע שהיא טהורה כי לא שלט בה הטס"א כ"כ וע"כ ראויה לאכילת ישראל וגם י"ל כי ענין מעלת גרה הוא מבחי' מדת הצדיקים שממעטין באכילה ושתיה בבח'י צדיק אוכל לשובע נפשו והרבה פעמים מתענים לגמרי כי מרגילין עצמן במדת העוה"ב שאין בו אכילה ושתיה רק אעפ"כ כל זמן שהם בעוה"ז אז ההכרח גם להם לאכילה ושתיה בבחי' עלית לגרתא הליך בנימוסה. ומאחר שהוא אצלם רק בבחינת הכרח ע"כ מסתפקין במיעוטא וריעותא דשבעא שויא עליהון בכל פעם ממה שאכלו כבר ביום אתמול או לפני שעות הרבה שזה בחי' מעלת גרה וניזונת ממה שאכלה כבר. וגם מאחר שאכילתן הוא רק על פי ההכרח ולא להנאת עצמן ע"כ הם בבחי' המלאכים כשבאו בעוה"ז אצל אברהם אבינו הוכרחו לאכול ונאמר בהם ויאכלו וארז,ל וכי אוכלין היו אלא נראין כאוכלין וראשון ראשון מסתלק כמו כן בחי' אכילת הצדיקים שהיא רק בבחי' נראין כאוכלין אכילה גשמיית כשאר בני אדם אבל באמת הם רחוקים מזה לגמרי וגם בשעת האכילה מחשבתם דבוקה למעלה למעלה וניזונין רק מאור החכמה העליונה וכמובן בזוה"ק וזה ג"כ בחי' מעלת גרה שנראה כאוכלת ואינה אוכלת.
segments.en: [§1] The signs of a pure animal and chayah are chewing the cud and having a split hoof . For our Sages taught: examine the teeth and you will forget the shoes [meaning: the signs indicate each other]. And behold: a person has thirty-two teeth — corresponding to the thirty-two paths of Chochmah — from which is the essential rectification of eating — as all of this is explained in the kavanos . And through them is the essential power of the feet — for "the end is embedded in the beginning." And the light of holy Chochmah and holy Torah illuminate a person from the aspect of his head to his feet — the aspect of: *"a lamp to my feet is Your word — and a light to my path"* [Tehillim 119:105] . And this is the aspect of: "the wisdom of the prudent — he understands his way" [Mishlei 14:8] — the aspect of: "and the path of the righteous is as the shining light" — as explained within. And see in the discourse of the Ari at the end of the Tikkunim — on the verse: "I have pondered my ways and I have returned my feet" — etc. And also: Malchus corresponds to the aspect of the feet — as is known. And this is the aspect of our Sages' teaching: it was found to illuminate his eyes and make him stand on his feet. [§2] And behold: correspondingly — the kingdom of the sitra achra — the aspect of Esav — also encompasses these two aspects of the klippa . And this is the aspect of what is said [Daniel 7] regarding the fourth beast: "its great iron teeth — eating and crushing — and its remainder it trampled with its feet." And therefore: in cattle and beasts — in which the filth of Esav and the spirit of folly and foolishness — the opposite of holy Chochmah — which is the essential aspect of human being — seizes most — therefore when it has teeth or fangs in the upper jaw — since then it generally does not chew its cud — for it chews and grinds its food with its teeth very well — until the food digests easily within it — and does not return and rise again into its mouth. And therefore it does not chew its cud. And it also does not have split hooves — so that it has an especially strong hold with its hooves on the ground. And therefore these are signs of impurity — for this indicates that the spirit of the sitra achra has seized it greatly — that it is addicted to the pleasure of eating — and imagines it has a firm and complete footing in this world. [§3] But if it chews its cud — this is because it has no teeth in the upper jaw — and therefore it cannot thoroughly chew and grind its food — and therefore the food returns and rises again into its mouth each time. And its hooves are split — so that it does not have as firm a hold with its hooves. From this it is apparent that the spirit of animality in it does not have great power and hold — and especially in the matter of its eating — where is the essential hold of animality — and where is the essential hold of Esav. And therefore: when one sees these signs — from its teeth to its hooves — one thereby knows that it is pure — for the sitra achra has not ruled it so strongly — and it is therefore fit for Israel's eating. And one may also say: the matter of chewing its cud alludes to the quality of the righteous — who minimize eating and drinking — the aspect of: "a righteous person eats to satisfy his soul" [Mishlei 13:25] — and many times they fast entirely — for they accustom themselves to the quality of the World to Come — in which there is no eating and drinking. But even so — as long as they are in this world — they too are compelled to eat and drink — the aspect of: "when you arrive in the city — proceed according to its customs." And since for them it is only in the aspect of necessity — they suffice with a small amount. And the unpleasantness of being full equals for them — each time — what they already ate yesterday or many hours ago — which is the aspect of chewing the cud — being sustained from what one ate already.

segments.he: ופרסומת דסוקות מורה גם כן על מדת הצדיקים שאין להם מעמד חזק על רגליהם בעוה"זרק תמיד הם בבחינת פרוס פריסת מלכותך כי יש להם ספיקות ושברון וחלוקה גם לענין שכרם בעוה"ב וכמו שדרז,ל למה נקוד על לולא. אמר דוד יודע אני שיש קבול שכר לצדיקים בעוה"ב ואיני יודע אם יש לי חלק עמהם וריב"ז אמר ולא עוד אלא שיש שתי דרכים לפני וכו'. מה שאין כן במדת הרשעים כל זה להיפוך כי כרוכים מאד אחר תאוות עוה"ז ואינם יכולים להשביע עצמם בבחי' והכלבים וכו' לא ידעו שבעה ובחי' ובטן רשעים תחסר. וזה בחינת שבהמה טמאה אינה מעלת גרה כי תיכף שבולעת המאכל כאלו נשכח זכרו ומצפת רק למאכל עוד וגם בשעת האכילה נלכדת ונקשרת מאד בגשמיות הנאת האכילה כי לועסת את המאכל היטב בשיניה וממלאת תאותה בכל האפשר ואעפ"כ לא ידעו שבעה וכאלו לא אכלה כלל. ופרסותיה קלוטות כי נדמה להם שמעמד רגליהם חזק בעוה"ז ולא עוד אלא שבטוחין בעצמן שיהיה להם גם שכר בעוה"ב ובחי' אלו הם סי' טומאה. וע"כ כל שמעלת גרה היא מפרסת פרסה חוץ מגלמל וכו' וכל שמפרסת פרסה מעלת גרה חוץ מחזיר וכו' כי דרז"ל גמל זו בבל שפן זו מדי ארנבת זו יון חזיר זה אדום וכו' נמצא כי מינים אלו מרמזין על כלל המלכיות דסט"א. ומחמת שישראל מוכרחים להיות בגלות בידם על כן יש בהם איזה סימן טהרה בכדי שלא יהיו כ,כ מהיפוך אל היפוך מבחי' קדושת ישראל לגמרי והסימן טהרה בעצמו מורה על בחינת ניצוצי הק' שנפלו אצלם שבשביל זה מוכרחין ישראל להשתעבד תחתים עד שיבררו כל ניצוצות הק' מביניהם כידוע. גם זהמרמז על מה שהיצה"ר מתלבש עצמו בתחלה במצוות כמבפ"נ וזה ג"כ מחמת זה כי קשה לו להסית את האדם תיכף בשעה ראשונה מהיפוך אל היפוחך וזה בחינת מה שדרז"ל על החזיר שפושט טלפיו לומר ראו שאני טהור וכו' היינו כנ"ל: וע"כ טמאה שילדה כמין טהורה וכו' אסורה. כי מאחר שמקורה היא מצד הסט"א והטומאה ע"כ לא מהני לה גם הסימני טהרה כי הם בבחי' מה שהיצה"ר מתלבש במצוות ובאמת הוא מצוה הבאה בעבירה וע,כ טהורה שילדה כמין טמאה מותרת. כי מאחר שידוע בבירור שמקורה הוא מצד הטהרה ע"כ אין משגיחין על הסימני טומאה כי מסתמא הם בבחי' גדולה עבירה לשמה וכו' ונביא שצוה לעבור על דברי תורה לפי שעה שומעין לו. וארז"ל עת לעשות לה' הפרו תורתך ועוד כיוצא בזה: וענין מה שהחיה החלב שלה מותר ודמה אסור מבואר כבר לעיל:
segments.en: [§5] And the split hooves also indicate the quality of the righteous — who have no firm footing in this world — but are always in the aspect of: "spread out the split of Your kingdom" — for they have doubts and uncertainty — and division — also regarding their reward in the World to Come. And as our Sages taught: why is the letter lulav dotted [in the verse about the gifts to Yosef]? David said: I know there is reward for the righteous in the World to Come — but I do not know whether I have a share with them. And Rabbi Yochanan ben Zakkai said: two paths are before me — etc. Whereas the quality of the wicked is all the opposite — for they are deeply addicted to the lusts of this world — and cannot satisfy themselves — the aspect of: "and the dogs — etc. — know not satisfaction" [Yeshayahu 56:11] — and: "and the belly of the wicked shall want" [Mishlei 13:25]. And this is the aspect of: an impure animal does not chew its cud — for immediately after it swallows the food — its memory is as if erased — and it only anticipates more food. And even during the eating it becomes completely seized and bound by the physical pleasure of eating — for it thoroughly chews the food with its teeth — and fulfils its desire to the extent possible. And even so: they know not satisfaction — and it is as if it ate nothing at all. And its hooves are closed — for it imagines its footing in this world is firm. And not only that — but it is confident that it will also have reward in the World to Come. And these aspects are signs of impurity.

segments.he: סימן פ"ב
segments.en: [§8] Only [hides of] kosher animals — cattle, beast, and fowl — are valid — for they are from the side of holiness — not from impure animals, which are from the side of the sitra d'masa'avutha [the impure side] — the aspect of the yetzer hara — the kingdom of the sitra achra. And therefore they must be placed on the head — where the mochin and intellect dwell — and on the arm opposite the heart — to subjugate thereby one's desires and thoughts of the heart to His service — for this is the essential thing: to bind oneself to the light of the intellect until it shines through all one's middos and movements, whose root is in the heart — as stated.

segments.he: וע"כ העופות שהם קלי התנועה ואור החיות מאיר בהם ביותר כנ"ל על כן המינים טהורים שבהם מרובים ביותר ורק כ"ד מינים טמאים יש בהם שיש להם איזה אחיזה מתוקף הדינים שמשתלשלין מבחינת כ"ד בתי דינים כידוע. אך מאחר שיש בהם מניםי טמאים ג"כ ע"כ מי שאינו מכירם בודק בסימני' כל עוף שהוא דורס ואוכל בידוע שהוא ממין טמא. מאחר שרואין בו ממדת האכזריות של חיות רעות בשביל האכילה. וכן אם קולט מן האויר ואוכל תיכף ואינו מניח על הארץ קודם שיבלעם מכל זה נראה שלהוט מאד אחר האכילה והוא סין טומאה. כי הוא מסטרא דעשו כנ"ל ובידוע שהוא דורס וטמא. ואם ידוע שאינו דורס יש ג' סימני טהרה וכו' ואעפ"כ אין לאוכלו אלא במסורת כי חוששין שמא הוא מבחינה זו של היצה"ר שמתלבש עצמו במצוות וסימני טהרה כנ"ל:
segments.en: [§1] And therefore fowl — which are light of movement and the light of life shines in them greatly — as stated — therefore there are very many species of pure ones among them. And only twenty-four impure species exist — which have some hold from the power of fierce judgments — that extend from the aspect of twenty-four courts [of judgment] — as is known. But since there are also impure species among them — therefore one who does not recognize them checks: any bird of prey that seizes — is certainly of an impure species — for one sees in it the quality of cruelty of wild animals — for the sake of eating. And likewise: if it catches from the air and eats immediately — without first placing on the ground — from all this it is apparent that it is greatly addicted to eating — and this is a sign of impurity. For it is from the sitra achra of Esav — as stated — and it is thereby known that it is a bird of prey and impure. And if it is known not to be a bird of prey: there are three signs of purity — etc. — and even so one may not eat it except by tradition — for we fear that perhaps it is from the aspect of the yetzer hara dressing itself in mitzvos and signs of purity — as stated. Siman 83 — Signs of Pure Fish סִימָן פ״ג

segments.he: סימן פ"ג
segments.en: [§9] This is the aspect of binding the Tefillin. And therefore one is obligated to touch them at every moment, and it is forbidden to divert one's attention from them — for this is the entire essence of placing Tefillin: to bind oneself to their holiness with a complete bond — in all one's movements, thoughts, and character traits — with full and settled awareness. And therefore "one who studies Torah is exempt from Tefillin all day" — as explained in Siman 38 — for the essential drawing-down of all these rectifications is through Torah study — as the verse says concerning Tefillin: *"so that the Torah of Hashem may be in your mouth"* [Shemos 13:9]. Nonetheless they too are obligated in Tefillin during Shema and the Tefillah — for that is the primary time for the drawing-down of the holy mochin, as is known.

segments.he: וע,כ גם בדגים שנבראו רק מן המים והם בבחי' עינא פקיחא וכנ"ל אעפ"כ יש גם בהם ממינים טמאים מחמת זה הנ,ל וע"כ נתנה התורה הק' בהם סימנים כל אשר לו סנפיר וקשקשת.
segments.en:
[§4]
And this: [Berachos 13a] — Rabbi Yochanan — (some say: Rabbi Meir) — when he finished the book of Iyov — where it is elaborated regarding the trials and sufferings that passed over Iyov through the prosecution of the Satan — who is himself the yetzer hara — and how afterwards Hashem blessed everything of Iyov doubly — and yet after all this he died and was forgotten and was as if he never was — until some hold that Iyov never existed and was never created but was only a parable. But our Sages challenged this view and refuted it — and therefore: his name and the name of his city. And therefore: when he finished the book of Iyov — he said: "the end of man is to die — and the end of the animal is for slaughter."

[§5]
And apparently this seems like cruelty — taking something that had life like himself and slaughtering and eating it. One must conclude: the person's reasoning is that on the contrary — this is the essential fullness of the animal's rectification when it ascends and is encompassed in the life-force of the person — as stated. But since the person himself will ultimately also die — what has been accomplished for it. And this: "and all are destined for death" — for all other creatures too are destined for death — the aspect of: *"they shall all perish — but You shall endure"* [Tehillim 102:27] — and as it is written: *"for the heavens shall vanish like smoke"* [Yeshayahu 51:6] — etc. — and thus our Sages taught — and it seems that all aspects of existence and being in this world are all in the aspect of death — even in the time of their existence and being they are as if they never were. For: "all that is destined to be burned is considered as already burned" — and similarly in many places — our Sages taught. And how can it be that from a perfect Maker — the Holy One, blessed be He — as it were — there should emerge an imperfect work — that everything is destined for death and destruction and loss — G-d forbid — after all was created with such wondrous and awesome wisdom — in the aspect of: "all of them in wisdom You made" — and wisdom is the source of life.

segments.he: הקשקשת היא להם כתרים ושמירה לבשרם וכן הסנפיר לשוט במהירות ולברוח מהרודפים אותם על כן הם סינמי טהרה כי החכם עיניו בראשו ויודע שהעולם מלא נסיונות וסכנות עצומות כי יש על האדם שונאים ואורבים ומסיתים ומסטינים הרבה וע"כ הוא זהיר בנפשו להחזיק מגן ותריס וצינה להגן עליו. וכן מזדרז בכל פעם לברוח ממה שצריך לברוח ולהנצל. משא"כ הכסיל בחשך הולך ואינו משים לבו לכל זה כלל וכמו שאמר הכתוב (משלי י"ד) חכם ירא וסור מרע וכסיל מתעבר ובוטח וזה בחי' כל שיש לו קשקשת יש לו סנפיר ואין לו קשקשת ואז אין לו סימני טהרה. כי אף שיכול לברוח ולהנצל מאיזה דבר רע לפעמים. אבל מאחר שאין לו קשקשת להגן עליו בתמידות בוודאי קשה לו להנצל ונופל ברוב הפעמים בידו שונאיו ונכשל במה שנכשל ואז ממילא נתרשל אח"כ גם מלהשתמש בבחינת הסנפיר שלו לברוח מהם כי אדרבא להיפוך חס ושלום כי עבירה גוררת עבירה כמו שארז"ל. ועיקר המגן והתריס בפני השונא שהוא היצר הרע הוא התורה הק' כמו שאמר הכתוב (משלי ב') יצפון לישרים תושיה מגן להולכי תום וזה שהקשו רז,ל וכי מאחר דכתיב קשקשת סנפיר למה ותרצו יגדיל תורה ויאדיר.
segments.en:
[§6]
And therefore one is compelled to say: all aspects of death and destruction in the world come only from the side of the absence of wisdom — in the aspect of: *"they shall die without wisdom"* [Iyov 4:21] — and our Sages taught: without the wisdom of Torah. For the essential thing is to merit holy wisdom and to subdue the physical and foolishness from the side of the sitra achra and the yetzer hara. All of this is only through Torah study — as stated. (And therefore when Iyov was having doubts regarding the Holy One and said: "You created the wise" — etc. — "You created the righteous — You created the wicked" — meaning: he held that man has no free choice — for one who is wicked was created in such a manner as to follow the counsel of his inclination. And Hashem answered him: "I created the yetzer hara — I created the Torah as its antidote.") And therefore the essential thing is that a person engage in Torah all his days — with all his powers of body — and through this subdue his inclination — the aspect of foolishness within him — and merit to accept the complete yoke of Heavenly Kingship — until he merits through this to attain the light of wisdom and intellect in every thing — until he draws close to Hashem — and merits to know and attain Him — through all the things in the world. And through the aspect of this wisdom and knowledge all things in the world come to their perfection and eternal and enduring purpose — for all was created only for this: b'gin d'yishtamodain leih [that they know Him] through all the things of the world.

[§7]
And this is what he said afterwards: "he who grew in Torah" — meaning: all his life-force and growth — all his days — is through Torah study. And this: "and whose toil was in Torah" — who toiled and exerted himself in it with all his strength — through which one gives strength to holy Malchus — etc. — as explained within — and prevails over his inclination which is from the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra. And this: "and brings pleasure to his Maker" — specifically and not to his yotzer [inclination] — G-d forbid. And this is the secret of: "pleasure" specifically — the aspect of: "the words of the wise are heard in gentleness" — as explained within — for through Torah study the ches and nun are joined — and one merits grace — and one's prayer is heard and accepted — and this is the essential pleasure of Hashem when holy grace is elevated and raised up and Israel's prayer is accepted — for Hashem longs for the prayer of the righteous — as elaborated in the discourse Or HaGanuz, ch. 15 — and in many places in his teachings. And this: "and grew with a good name" — meaning: all his days he is possessed of good attributes and good deeds — which is the essential ultimate purpose of Torah and wisdom. And also: for a good name is the aspect of the grace and importance mentioned — the aspect of: "for you found grace in My eyes and I know you by name" [Shemos 33:17]. And this: "and departed with a good name."

segments.he: היינו שהתורה הקדושה מרמזת לנו כל העצות ותחבולות שצריכין למלחמה הזאת ע"כ הגם כי ממילא ידוע שכל מי שי לו קשקשת יש לו סנפיר כנ"ל אף על פי כן התורה הק' מבארת זאת בפירוש לידע שגם העצה הזאת לברוח בשעה שצרייכן לברוח. אבל הכל רק בכח התורה הק' שעי"ז נותן כח למלכות דקדושה בחי' היצ"ט בס להתגבר כנגד היצמה"ר כנ"ל. וזה יגדיל תורה ועי"ז ויאדיר הוא מל' חיזוק וכח וגם מל' חדיר ומושל בחי' הכח דקדושה שמקבל בח'י המלכות דקדושה עי"ז כנ"ל. וזה שארז"ל ומנין דהאי קשקשת לבושא הוא דכתי' ושריון קשקשים הוא לבוש נמצא מבואר שקשקשת הוא בחי' מגן ותריס ושריון ועיין בספר טעמי המצוות ותבין עוד לענינינו:
segments.en: [§3] Meaning: holy Torah alludes to us all the counsel and strategies needed for this battle — and therefore even though it is already self-evident that all who have scales have fins — even so holy Torah explains it explicitly — to make known that even this counsel — to flee when one must flee — all of it is only through the power of holy Torah — through which one gives strength to holy Malchus — the aspect of the yetzer tov — to prevail against the yetzer hara — as stated. And this: yagdil Torah — and through this: v'yadir — which is from the language of strengthening and power — and also from the language of rule and mastery — the aspect of the holy power that Malchus receives through this — as stated. And this is what our Sages taught: from where [do we know] that scales are a garment? — as it is written: "and an armor of scales" [Shmuel I 17:5] — it is thereby explained: scales are the aspect of a shield and armor and coat of mail. And see in the book of Ta'amei HaMitzvos and you will understand further for our subject. Siman 84 — Laws of Insects סִימָן פ״ד [§1] The laws of insects. And this is the aspect of the impurity of the eight creeping creatures mentioned in the Torah — which are the weasel, the mouse — etc. — and it is cited in the writings that they correspond to the aspects of the roots of the klippos mixed in the dross of the eight kings of Edom — etc. And regarding our subject: for they are from the sitra achra of Esav — who is Edom — who grows strong essentially to separate a person from holy Chochmah — the aspect of ches . And therefore correspondingly they too are eight [ ches ]. And holy Chochmah is the aspect of holiness. And they are completely impure — the opposite of the aspect of holiness. And therefore their impurity is as a lentil — which is the aspect of what was the beginning of Esav's wickedness — and the despising of the birthright — which is the aspect of holy Chochmah — was for the sake of a lentil stew — as is explained in the parashah . And this is also the aspect of the prohibition of: "all the creeping creature that creeps upon the earth" — and the Torah calls them sheketz [abomination] — etc. — for they are of very low levels — the very opposite of the aspect of holy life-force — which is the aspect of ches and nun — the aspects of grace and beauty and splendor — and they are disgusting and repulsive. Therefore: "you shall not make your souls abominable through animal or through bird" — and similarly regarding the impure species of water — it is said of them: sheketz — for all of them are from the aspect of the sitra achra — which is disgusting and abominable — the aspect of what our Sages taught: "if that villain encounters you — etc." — the aspect of what is said [Yirmiyahu 49] about Edom: "contemptible among men." And therefore they make the souls of those who eat them abominable. [§2] And therefore they are forbidden only if the insects grew while still attached [to the ground] — which is called "the creeping creature that creeps upon the earth." But those that form in something detached are not forbidden unless they separated — for the essential distinction between a human being and an animal is: the spirit of the human ascends upward — and the spirit of the animal descends downward to the earth — and therefore it is greatly addicted to physicality and earthliness — and has no daas or intellect. And therefore: insects that creep literally on the earth — and all their growth is close to the actual earth — they are therefore very weak and of very little life-force. And as our Sages taught: any creature that has no bone does not survive twelve months. And therefore all of them are forbidden. And likewise water insects that spring up while attached — or at least flow — etc. — as explained in the Shulchan Aruch . But those in water in vessels — and likewise those in fruits — those that formed in something detached — are not in the category of "the creeping creature that creeps on the earth" — unless they separated. For then the spirit of impurity — wandering the earth — from the aspect of the sitra achra of Esav — has already seized them. And the general rule: those insects that formed while attached are from the aspect of the sitra achra — the aspect of Esav — of whom it is said: "the wicked are estranged from the womb" [Tehillim 58:4]. And therefore they are forbidden immediately. But those waters or fruits that were detached from their place of attachment in purity and fitness — and had no insects in them at that time — and were fit then for Israel's food without any checking at all — therefore: if insects formed in them afterwards — they are permitted as long as they have not separated. For they are in the aspect of: "He has not looked upon iniquity in Yaakov" — as stated — since they are included in the permitted food and have not separated and distinguished themselves from it at all — the name of prohibition has not fallen upon them. (And even if they separated — in a place of rabbinic lenience — see in the Shulchan Aruch the particulars.) But if they separated from the produce or food and became a matter in their own right — the sitra achra has already found a place to fall upon them — and then even if they return — they are forbidden. And from this some small allusions are also understood regarding a person's service. Siman 85 — Signs of Pure Locusts סִימָן פ״ה

segments.he: סימן פ"ד
segments.en: [§1] And this is the aspect of the Morning Blessings — whose essential foundation is to guide a person so that through every affair and matter he is aroused toward His service and gives thanks and blesses Him for every single thing — for example: upon hearing the rooster crow, one recites "Who gives the rooster understanding" — etc. When dressing, one recites "Who clothes the naked." And likewise "Who opens the eyes of the blind," "Who releases the bound" — and all the rest through "Who removes sleep" — etc.

segments.he: הלכות תולעים. וזה בחי' טומאת השמונה שרצים האמורים בתורה שהם החולד והעכבר וכו' ומובא בכתבים שהם כנגד בחינת שרשי הקליפות המעורבים בהסיגים שבשמונה מלכי אדום וכו'. ולענינינו כי הם מסטרא דעשו הוא אדום שמתגבר העיקר להפריד את האדם מבחינת החכמה דקדושה שהיא בחינת חי"ת ועל כן לעןומת זה הם ג"כ חי"ת. והחכמה דקדושה היא בחינת קדש. והם טמאים לגמרי ההיפוך מבחי' קדש. וע"כ טומאתן כעדשה. שזה בחינת מה שתחלת רשעתו של עשו ומה שביזה את הבכורה שהיא בחינת החכמה דקדושה היה בשביל נזיד עדשים כמבואר בפרשה. וזה ג"כ בחי' איסור כל השרץ השורץ על הארץ והתורה קראה אותו שקץ הוא לכם וכו' כי היא ממדריגות נמוכות מאד שהם היפוך בחי' החות דקדושה שהיא בבחי' חי"ת ונו"ן בחי' חן והידור ויופי והם משוקצים ומאוסים לכן ולא תשקצו את נפשותיכם בבהמה ובעוף וכן במינים הטמאים שבמים נאמר בהם שקץ כי כולם הם מבחי' הטס"א שהוא משוקץ ומתועב בבחי' מה שארז"ל אם פגע בך מנוול זה וכו' בבחינת מה שנאמ (ירמיהו מ"ט) על אדום בזוי באדם. וע"כ הם משקצין את נפשות האוכלם. וע"כ אינם אסורים אלא תולעים הגדלים במחובר שזה נקרא השורץ על הררץ משא"כ הנעשין בתלוש אינן אסורין אא"כ פירשו כי עיקר ההבדל בין האדם לבהמה היא כי רוח האדם העולה היא למעלה ורוח הבהמה היורדת היא למטבה לארץ ועל כן היא להוטה מאד רק אחר הגשמיות והארציות ואין לה דעת ושכל. וע"כ השרצים השורצים על הארץ ממש וכל גידולם היא בסמוך לארץ ממש וע,כ הם חלושים ומעוטי החיות מאד וכמו שארז"ל כל בריה שאין לה עצם אינה מתקיימת י"ב חודש וע,כ אסורים כולם וכן בשרצי המים הנובעים במחובר או שעכ"פ הם מושכים וכו' כמבואר בשו"ע משא"כ אותם שבמים שבכלים וכן בפירות אותן שנתהוו בתלוש אינן בכלל השורץ על הארץ אא"כ פירשו שאז נאחז בהם כבר הרוח הטומאה המשוטט בארץ שהוא מבחינת הטס"א סטרא דעשו. והכלל כי אלו התולעים שנתהוו במחובר הם מבחינת הסט"א בחינת עשו שנאמר עליו זורו רשעים מרחם. וע,כ הם אסורים תיכף. אבל אותן המים או הפירות שנעקרו ממקום חיבורם בטהרה ובכשרות ולא היו בם תולעים והיו ראוים אז למאכל ישראל בלי שום בדיקה כלל ע"כ אם נתהוו בהן אח"כ תולעים מותרים כל זמין שלא פירשו כי הם בבחי' לא הביט און ביעקב הנ"ל מאחר שהם בכלל המאכל של היתר ולא נפרשו ונבדלו ממנו כלל לא חל עליהם שם איסור (ואפילו אם פירשו במקום רבותייהו עיין בשו"ע הפרטים בזה) משא"כ אם פירשו מהמקשה או מהמאכל ונחשבו לענין בפני עצמו אז כבר מצאה הסט"א מקום לחול עליהם ואז אע"פ שחזו אסורים. ומזה מובן גם כן לענין עבודת האדם איזה רמזים קצת:
segments.en:
[§9]
And perhaps this is also the intention of our Sages' teaching: "let a person always arouse" — etc. — "and if not — let him engage in Torah" — etc. — "and if not — let him recall the day of death" — etc. — meaning: what has not helped him in the Torah study to prevail over the yetzer hara is presumably because he did not apply his heart sufficiently to his purpose — and therefore he engages in Torah with true intention until he merits to subdue his inclination — which is itself the essential sitra d'mosa — and merits to bind himself to the light of life — the aspect of holy intellect — as stated. It emerges that specifically through the aspect of death one merits life. And this is the aspect of our Sages' teaching: "the living — these are the righteous who in their death are called living — and the wicked who in their lives are called dead" — for since they are truly destined for death and give no thought to this at all — and are occupied all their days with the vanities of the world — which are all in the aspect of death — as stated — therefore specifically through their lives they sink deeper each time into the sitra d'mosa — until in their lives they are called dead — and they themselves know nothing — for they give no thought whatsoever to any matter — and through this they are distant from all aspects of holy knowledge to the ultimate degree. And the righteous — specifically through knowing they will die — through this they merit the ultimate complete knowledge which is the essential life — until even in their death they are called living.

[§10]
And this we find regarding Yaakov and Esav themselves — for Esav said: "behold I am going to die — and what use is the birthright to me?" [Bereishis 25:32] — and he thereby concluded himself to death — to the point that he despised the birthright — which is the aspect of Chochmah — the essential life. And Yaakov our father — who occupied himself only with this — therefore received the birthright and the blessing — and merited to true life — and our Sages said about him: "Yaakov our father did not die" — and therefore in truth he is the aspect of the rectification and completion of all Creation — as our Sages taught: "my world — my world — who created you? — etc. — Yaakov" — etc. — as stated.

segments.he: סימן פ"ה
segments.en: [§2] For sleep is the aspect of the temporary withdrawal of daas [knowledge] and mochin — and it is also for the person's benefit, in order that he merit the renewal of the mochin — this being the aspect of "a new face" — for *"a person's wisdom illuminates his face"* [Koheles 8:1]. And therefore specifically when he washes his face, he recites "Who removes sleep."

segments.he: סימני חגבים. כל שיש לו ד' רגלים וד' כנפים וכנפיו חופין את רוב גופו וכו' ויש לו שני כרעים לנתר בהן כי מכל זה מבואר שכח התנועה שלו גדול ביותר לברוח מהאויבים וגם כנפיו חופין את רוב גופו כמגן ותריס כנ"ל וגם כח העפיפה גדול בהם ביותר ולא עוד אלא שי לו כרעים לנתר ולקפוץ על גשמיות מקום הארץ וכל אלו הם סימני טהרתו ואף על פי כן צריך מסורת זששמו חגב שהוא מין טהור כי הסט"א משתמשת ג"כ לפעמים ומתלבשת עצמה בבחי' אלו ודייקא על ידי שהיא קלת התנועה כ"כ אעפ"כ מאחר שיש בהם גם מניים טמאים ע"כ הטעות והחילוף והתמורה מצוי ביותר וצריך דייקא מסורת וע,כ הטהורי' אין צריכין שחיטה כי המיעוט יש בהם מיסוד העפר והרוב מהיסודות הדקים ביותר:
segments.en: [§1] The signs of locusts: all that has four legs and four wings — and its wings cover the majority of its body — etc. — and it has two jumping legs . For from all of this it is apparent that its power of movement is greatest — to flee from enemies — and also its wings cover the majority of its body like a shield and armor — as stated — and also its power of flight is very great. And not only that — but it also has jumping legs — to leap and spring above the physicality of the earthly place. And all of these are signs of its purity. And even so: a tradition is required that its name is chagav — a pure species — for the sitra achra also sometimes makes use of and dresses itself in these aspects. And specifically because it is so light of movement — even so: since there are also impure species among them — the error and exchange and transposition are very common — and therefore a tradition is specifically required. And therefore the pure ones require no shechitah — for the majority of them is from the finest elements — and the minority from the element of earth. Siman 86 — Signs of Eggs סִימָן פ״ו [§1] The signs of eggs — to recognize whether they are from pure fowl: if both its heads are round or both are pointed — or if the yolk was on the outside and the white on the inside — it is known to be the egg of an impure bird — etc. [§2] For a pointed head alludes to the sharpening of the mochin — the aspect of the light of supernal Chochmah — the aspect of what is said [Iyov 41:22]: "beneath him are sharp pieces of pottery" — Rashi explains: rays of the sun — which is the aspect of the light of Chochmah . And likewise: [Mishlei 27:17]: "and a man sharpens the face of his fellow" — Rashi explains: referring to Torah scholars who sharpen each other. And a round head alludes to the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of a circle — the aspect of: "and the head is round toward the throne from behind" — and as cited in the discourse Heichal HaKodesh , Siman 59. And it is known: the sitra achra begins in connection and ends in separation — the aspect of: "then all evildoers shall be scattered" [Tehillim 92:10]. And therefore: if both its heads are round — it alludes to it being from the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra . And likewise: if both its heads are pointed — it alludes to it being from the aspect of the male — the aspect of the intellect of the sitra achra . [§3] And therefore: even a pure egg — whose one head is round and one head is pointed — one does not rely on it until asking the hunter — etc. — for in holiness there is a complete and holy union between male and female — which are the aspects of Chochmah and Malchus. And therefore the essential binding of the egg is in its pointed head — where the drop of the male bird binds — as explained in the Beis Yosef , Siman 66, in the name of most authorities — see there. And this: for this very pointed head is also in the aspect of the male — as stated. And according to the opinion that holds the binding is in the round head — this too can be explained according to the matter above — as is self-evident. And therefore: if the yolk is on the outside and the white is on the inside — this too is a sign that it is from an impure bird. For the white — which is white — is from the aspect of the male — the aspect of: "a man who emits white" — etc. — and the yolk is from the aspect of the female. And in the sitra achra — the female rules over the male — as explained in the holy Zohar regarding yoter al hakaved [the lobe of the liver] — and likewise regarding pitora asher al ha-nahar [the table that is on the river]. But even if one head is round and one pointed — and the white is on the outside and the yolk inside — even so it is possible that it is the egg of an impure bird. For falsehood does not endure unless there is some truth at its beginning. And likewise: the sitra achra also begins in connection — from which flows the fact that the yetzer hara first dresses itself in mitzvos — for they mimic like a monkey before a man. Therefore one does not rely on these signs until asking the hunter — etc. — as explained in the Shulchan Aruch . Nachas HaShulchan — Part VII (Yoreh Deah) · Segment 2 · Simanim 30–87 Translated faithfully from the Hebrew of Rabbi Nachman of Tchehrin ז״ל Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman ✦ Nachas HaShulchan — Part VII (Yoreh Deah), Segment 3: Simanim 87–178 נַחַת הַשֻּׁלְחָן Nachas HaShulchan — Part VII Yoreh Deah · Segment 3 · Simanim 87–178 Basar b'Chalav · Taaruvos · Foods of Non-Jews · Avodah Zarah · Ribbis · Kilayim By Rabbi Nachman of Tchehrin ז״ל ✦ ✦ ✦ Siman 87 and on — Basar b'Chalav : Meat with Milk סִימָן פ״ז וְכוּ׳ — בָּשָׂר בְּחָלָב [§1] The laws of basar b'chalav [meat with milk] — etc. It is explained in the holy Zohar [Mishpatim 125] that through basar b'chalav one gives strength to the sitra achra to suckle from holiness — G-d forbid — etc. — see there. And from this it is self-evident that then the sitra achra has even more power to overpower. And also: through this it has more power to dress itself in mitzvos and deceive the person — and through this one becomes separated and distanced from holy wisdom and intellect and life-force — which is the essential aspect of the tzelem Elokim [Divine Image] that illuminates the face of man — the aspect of: "a man's wisdom illuminates his face" — as explained in Siman 57. And therefore it is explained in the holy Zohar there: that through basar b'chalav the tzelem Elokim departs from him. And see in the Tikkunim , Tikkun 14 — where it is explained that the prohibition of basar b'chalav is in the aspect of: *"you shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together"* [Devarim 22:10] . And there in Tikkun 10 of the later Tikkunim it is explained: ox and donkey are the aspect of the klippos of Esav and Yishmael — which are the totality of the kingdoms of the sitra achra — as stated. And this: the prohibition of basar b'chalav is juxtaposed in Parshas Mishpatim and in Parshas Yisro to the mitzvah of bikkurim — for this mitzvah is from the side of the holiness of holy intellect and wisdom — the aspect of the birthright. And in Parshas Reeh this mitzvah is juxtaposed to the mitzvah of maaser — which is from the aspect of Malchus — as is known.

segments.he: סימן פ"ו
segments.en: [§3] And what follows it [in the blessing]: "accustom us in Your Torah" — etc. — "and cleave us to the good inclination" — etc. — "and bend our inclination to be subjugated to You" — for one prays about the bending of the yetzer hara, who wants to separate the person from the light of the intellect — and to merit the good inclination [yetzer tov], which is the aspect of misken v'chacham [poor and wise], who guides a person to cleave only to the light of holy wisdom and intellect.

segments.he: סימני בצים להכיר שהם מעוף טהור אם שני ראשיה כדין או חדין או שהיה חלמון מבחוץ וחלבון מבפנים בידוע שהוא ביצת עוף טמא וכו'.
segments.en:
סִימָן כ׳

[§1]
And therefore one must be precise in shechitah — not to slaughter above the measured area toward the head — and not below the measured area close to the body. For since the shechitah is to nullify the aspect of the spirit of folly — the spirit of Esav the hairy man — who seizes in the spirit of animality — and the essential hold of Esav in eating is from the side of the body and below — where is the essential physical nature — and the vessels of digestion. But from the side of the head — he has no strong hold — for the head is in the aspect of mochin — the opposite of the aspect of Esav. And therefore: if one slaughters above toward the head — one's shechitah does not accomplish the subduing of the aspect of the klippa of Esav — since he has no strong hold there.

[§2]
And therefore our Sages taught [Berachos 14] regarding one sitting in a fast who tastes — it is of no consequence — and they explained: meaning he tastes and spits out — etc. — it emerges that since it does not swallow and descend into the body — it is not included in eating. And likewise one must not slaughter below — close to the body — for there the hold of Esav grows strong most. And therefore they gave the sign for the lower limit — for the esophagus: until the point where it becomes hairy — (and Rashi explained: where hair begins there) — and this is a sign of the hold of Esav the hairy man — who holds there most. And this: "above — until where?" — for the esophagus: until the breadth of a hand's grasp — for since it still extends from the esophagus — in which the hold of Esav is — as cited in Orach Chaim in the name of the holy Zohar — even so — for the law of shechitah — it is not in the category of the esophagus — only turbatz haoshut [the collar of the esophagus] — for it is already close to the head and mochin — as stated — therefore its measure is a hand's grasp — the aspect of: "and his hand grasps the heel of Esav" [Bereishis 25:26]. And therefore there is already no place of shechitah there. And even though the entire windpipe is from the aspect of Yaakov — and shechitah can apply there — this is understood from what we hinted above: for sometimes the yetzer hara dresses in mitzvos — the aspect of Esav wearing Yaakov's garments. (Corresponding to one against the other — as understood. And therefore in cattle — where the hold of Esav is strongest — he therefore seizes also in the windpipe below toward the body — and so with other creatures — and the essential in their eating. Therefore they gave a sign also for the windpipe below: until where the neck stretches out to graze. To graze specifically — which is their eating — until there is the aspect of Esav's hold also in the windpipe — such that it can be nullified and subdued through shechitah. And from there downward — already close to the body — as stated regarding the esophagus. And there is no place of sweetening and rectification through shechitah. And therefore they gave a sign to know after shechitah: until the top of the lobe when one blows it up — etc. — for in the lung and the lobes there is the vital breath of the animal — etc. — the aspect of: "the spirit of the beast that goes downward" — etc. — and there is the essential hold of the stormy spirit of Esav — and therefore there is no place of shechitah there.)

segments.he: כי ראשה חד מרמז לחידוד המוחין בחינת אור החכמה העליונה בבחי' שנאמר (איוב מ"א) תחתיו חדודי חרש פירש"י זהרורי שמש שזה בחי' אור החכמה וכן (משלי כ"ז) ואיש יחד פני רעהו פירש"י לתמידי חכמים המחדדין זה לזה. וראשה כד מרמז לבחינת מלכות שהיא בחי' עיגולא בחינת וראש עגול לכסא מאחריו וכמובא במאמר היכל הקודש סימן נ"ט. והנה ידוע כי הסט"א שארי בחיבורא וסיים בפרודא בחינת יתפרדו כל פועל יאון. ועל כן אם שני ראשיה כדין מרמז שהוא מבחי' מלכות דסט"א וכן אם שני ראשיה חדין מרמז שהיא מבחינת דוכרא בחי' השכל דסט"א.
segments.en: [§2] And therefore when a person has a bad dream, he should know that this too is from Heaven — to reflect upon his ways — in the aspect of: *"for G-d has made it, so that they should fear before Him"* [Koheles 3:14] — this is a bad dream — for even from these aspects — which flow from the sitra d'mosa, G-d forbid — that befall a person — one must also extract hints of wisdom — for there too, in great concealment, are some sparks and holy life-force — only in great contraction — as stated.

segments.he: וע"כ גם בביצה טהורה שראשה אחד כד וראשה אחד חד אין סומכין עד שישאל לציד וכו' כי בקדושה יש יחוד שלם וקדוש בין דכר ונוקבא שהם בחינת החכמה והמלכות. ועל כן עיקר קשר הביצה הוא בראשה החד ששם נקשר טיפת התרנגול הזכר וכמבואר בבית יוסף סימן ס"ו בשם רוב המפרשים עיי"ש וזה כי הראש זה החד בעצמו הוא גם כן בבח'י דוכרא כנ"ל ולשיטת האומרים שהקשר הוא בראש הכד יש לבאר ג"כ ע"פ ענין הנ"ל כמובן וע,כ אם החלמון מבחוץ והחלבון מבפנים הוא ג,כ סימן שהיא מעוף טמא. כי החלבון שהוא לובן הוא מבחי' דוכרא בחי' איש מזריע לובן וכו' והחלמון היא מבח'י נוקבא ו בסט"א נוקבא שליט על דוכרא כמבואר בזוה"ק בענין יותר על הכבד וכן בענין פתורה אשר על הנהר. אך אפילו אם ראשה אחד כד וראשה אחד חד וחלבון מבחוץ וחלמון מבפנים אעפ"כ אפשר שהוא ביצת עוף טמא. כי אין השקר מתקיים אא"כ יש בו אמת בתחלתו וכן הסט"א שארי ג"כ בחיבורא שמזה נמשך מה שהיצה"ר מתלבש עצמו בתחלה במצוות כי הם מדמים עצמם כקוף בנפי אדם. ע"כ אין סומכין על סימנים אלו עד שישאל לצידוכו' כמבואר בשו"ע
segments.en:
סִימָן כ״א

[§1]
And therefore initially one must slaughter even a fowl through the majority of both signs — since the hold of Esav is in both — as stated. But after the fact: the majority of one sign suffices for fowl — since it was created from the swamp and the hold of physicality and foolishness is not as strong in it — as explained above somewhat. And all the more so: the windpipe — which is invalidated in its slaughter only if the majority is cut invalidly. For since through it the vital breath enters and exits — and for Israel its root is in the aspect of holiness — the aspect of Yaakov — therefore it is invalidated only through the majority — unlike the esophagus which is the aspect of Esav — which is invalidated in the smallest amount. And this is similar to our Sages' teaching regarding evil thought: Hashem does not join it to action — and this applies specifically to Israel — etc. — as stated.

סִימָן כ״א וְכוּ׳

[§1]
To distance from forbidden relations — etc. For since the essential strengthening of the sitra achra and the yetzer hara is in forbidden relations — as cited in the holy Zohar [Vayikra 15b] — for this is the very opposite of the aspect of drawing these rectifications — the aspect of holy union and connection. And through forbidden relations one causes union and connection of the sitra achra — G-d forbid — the aspect of the destruction of the world — G-d forbid. And therefore the yetzer hara is most aroused over this. Therefore our holy Torah has warned to distance greatly from this. And the Sages made many fences in this — and forbade even seclusion with an unmarried woman. And all for the reason stated. And this is the aspect of the severity of the prohibition of wasting seed — G-d forbid. For when one emits drops of the brain without a vessel — the sitra achra seizes them. And evil creatures are formed from them — which are the most intense klippos and evil inclinations. And therefore: one who stumbles in this sin — G-d forbid — is called wicked — as our Sages taught. And this was the sin of the generation of the flood — of whom it is said: *"for great was the evil of man on the earth — and all the inclination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil all the day"* [Bereishis 6:5] — for through this the evil inclinations are aroused in one even more — until through this the world was utterly destroyed — and the flood came and swept them away. And this: *"Hashem sat at the flood — and Hashem sits as King forever"* [Tehillim 29:10]. For through their being destroyed — the aspect of holy Malchus was elevated. And this is the aspect of the great care required of a person in the holiness of marital union. For one must be careful that it be with great holiness — for the root of holy union and connection is from supernal Chochmah — called holiness. And as understood in the holy Zohar on the verse: *"and also truly she is my sister — the daughter of my father"* [Bereishis 20:12] — etc. And through this one merits worthy children — through whom the world is built — and through whom the Heavenly Kingdom is revealed. And one merits to receive the light of the intellect in holiness — and to draw the attainment of divinity in the world — which is the essential purpose of Creation — as stated.

segments.he: סימן פ"ז וכו'
segments.en: [§4] And this: "and grant us" — etc. — "chen [grace]" — etc. — for through this one merits the chen mentioned above. And this: "and bestow upon us good kindnesses" — for as is explained in the holy Zohar: "Good — the good itself is wholly within it; chesed that spreads outward" — and this is also the aspect of the illumination of the intellect and the contraction. And this: "Who bestows good kindnesses upon His people Israel" — for thus does Hashem conduct Himself with His people Israel, in the aspect of bestowing good kindnesses: illuminating for them at all times the light of the holy intellect through various vestments and contractions, so that they can receive and benefit from His light. And this is adjacent to the blessing of "Who removes sleep" — for this too is the matter of sleep: in order to receive through it a renewed illumination of the mochin — in the aspect of "they are new every morning" — as stated above. And this: "and save us from the brazen-faced" — the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra, as is known.
