segments.he: הלכות בשר בחלב וכו'. מבואר בזוה,ק משפטים דף קכ"ה כי ע"י בשר בחלב נותנין כח לסט"א לינק מהקדושה ח"ו וכו' עיי"ש וממילא מובן כי אז יש כח להסט,א להתגבר ביותר. גם עי"ז יש לו כח ביותר להתלבש במצוות ולהטעות את האדם ועי"ז נפרד ונתרחק מהחכמה והשכל והחיות דקדושה שזה עיקר בחי' צלם אלהים המאיר בפני האדם בחי' חכמת אדם תאיר פניו וכמבוארבסי' נ"ז. וע"כ מבואר בזוה"ק שם שע,י בשר בחלב סר ממנו הצלם אלהים ועיין בתיקונים תיקון י"ד מבואר שאיסור בשר בחלב הוא בבחינת לא תחרוש בשור ובחמור יחדיו ושם מבואר בתיקון יו"ד מהתיקונים האחרונים ששור וחמור הם בחינת קליפת עשו וישמעאל שהם כלל המלכיות דסט"א כנ"ל. וזה שנסמך איסור בשר בחלב בפרשת משפטים ובפ' יתרו למצוות ביכורים שמצוה זו היא מצד בח'י קדושת החכמה והשכל דקדושה שהוא בחי' בכורה וכמובן גם בתיקון י"ד הנ"ל. ובפרש' ראה נסמכה מצוה זו למצוות עשר תעשר שהיא מבחי' מלכות כידוע.
segments.en: [§1] The laws of basar b'chalav [meat with milk] — etc. It is explained in the holy Zohar [Mishpatim 125] that through basar b'chalav one gives strength to the sitra achra to suckle from holiness — G-d forbid — etc. — see there. And from this it is self-evident that then the sitra achra has even more power to overpower. And also: through this it has more power to dress itself in mitzvos and deceive the person — and through this one becomes separated and distanced from holy wisdom and intellect and life-force — which is the essential aspect of the tzelem Elokim [Divine Image] that illuminates the face of man — the aspect of: "a man's wisdom illuminates his face" — as explained in Siman 57. And therefore it is explained in the holy Zohar there: that through basar b'chalav the tzelem Elokim departs from him. And see in the Tikkunim , Tikkun 14 — where it is explained that the prohibition of basar b'chalav is in the aspect of: *"you shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together"* [Devarim 22:10] . And there in Tikkun 10 of the later Tikkunim it is explained: ox and donkey are the aspect of the klippos of Esav and Yishmael — which are the totality of the kingdoms of the sitra achra — as stated. And this: the prohibition of basar b'chalav is juxtaposed in Parshas Mishpatim and in Parshas Yisro to the mitzvah of bikkurim — for this mitzvah is from the side of the holiness of holy intellect and wisdom — the aspect of the birthright. And in Parshas Reeh this mitzvah is juxtaposed to the mitzvah of maaser — which is from the aspect of Malchus — as is known.

segments.he: כי ע"י בב"ח פוגמין בבחי' המשכת התיקונים הנ"ל. וע"כ כשקטרגו המלאכים על קבלת התורה שעל ידה זוכין לבחי' התיקונים הנ"ל השיב להם הקב"ה והלא אכלתם בשר בחלב אצל אברהם היינו כנ"ל. כי עי"ז פוגמין בבחי' המשכת התיקונים הנ"ל. וע"כ הקפידה התורה לענין בב"ח רק בבשר בהמה דייקא. שבה עיקר אחיזת הרוח שטות שהוא מבחי' עשו רק שמבררין איתה ע"י שחיטה וכו' כנ"ל. וע"כ צריכה שחיטת שני הסימנים ודמה אינה טעון כיסוי והחלב שלה אסור כנ"ל. משא"כ בבשר חיה שמאיר בה אור החיות דקדושה ביותר ע"כ החלב שלה מותר ודמה טעון כיסוי. וכל שכן עוף שאין צריך רק שחיטת סימן אחד כנ"ל ע"כ אין בהם מה"ת איסור בשר בחלב. אבל אעפ"כ אסורין ג"כ מדרבנן. וע"כ הוציאה התורה הק' איסור זה בלשון לא תבשל גדי בחלב אמו אע"פ שגדי כולל כל הבהמות וזה מחמת שבגדי יש בחי' אחיזה יתירה לבחי' עשו איש שעיר. ועל כן נאמר אצל יעקב ואת עורות גדיי העיזים הלבישה על ידיו וכו' ונאמר אח"כ ולא היכרו כי היו ידיו כידי עשו אחיר שעירות ועיין בזוה,ק מה שביאר בענין הגדיי עיזים מה שאעפ"כ הם מותרות לאכילת ישראל ועל כן רמזה התורה שמחמת שבבשר בהמה שהיא בחי' גדי יש אחיזה לבחי' עשו ביותר רק שישרא למתקנים אותו ע"י מצוות שחיטה וניקור ומליחה וע"כ אם יבשל אותו בחלב בהמה שנמשך ונתברר מדמה בבחי' דם נעכר ונעשה חלב ונתברר כ"כ מעצמו בכח העליון הבא עליו מלמעלה ששרשו מבחי' הלובן העליון בחי' חכמה ומחשבה אשר על ידהכל הבירורים דקדושה בבחינת כולהו במחשבה איתברירו ומשם נמתק אדמימות הדם שנאחז בו סטרא דעשו הוא אדום עד שנתהפך ללובן בחי' לבנונית החלב עד שהותר לאכילת ישראל בלי שום תיקון כלל. וזה בחינת (משלי כ"ז) ודי חלב עזים ללחמך וכו' וחיים לנערותיך כי היא מבחינת חכמה וחיים כנ"ל. ע"כ אם יבשל בו בשר בהמה שנאחז בו הרבה מסטרא דעשו על ידי זה יתן לו מקום להתגבר ביותר ח"ו. וע"כ הקפידה התורה דייקא בדרך בישול כי על ידי הבישול נתערבין הטעמים של זה בזה ביותר עד שנכללין יחד ממש והיו לאחדים ועי,ז יש לו כח ליניק ולהתגבר ביותר וע"כ הבישול בעצמו ג"כ אסור. וכן חמור איסורו כ"כ עד שנאסר אפילו בהנאה כי רק אפיל וההנאה לבד שיקבל האדם מזהיפגום בנפשו מאד כי עי"ז יתאחז בו מטסרא דעשו שאסור בהנאה לגמרי כי כל טובתן של רשעים רעה הוא אצל הצדיקים וכמובן גם בענין יעקב אבינו ע"ה כשאמר לו עשו אציגה נא וכו'. וע"כ אינו נוהג אלא בבשר בהמה טהורה בחלב טהורה ששניהם היתר. ואפיל ובשר נבלה או חלב אעפ"כ על כל פנים הם ממין היתר.
segments.en: [§2] For through basar b'chalav one damages the aspect of drawing these rectifications. And therefore: when the angels prosecuted against the receiving of the Torah — through which one merits the aspect of these rectifications — the Holy One, blessed be He, replied to them: "did you not eat meat with milk at Avraham's home?" — as stated. For through this one damages the aspect of drawing these rectifications. And therefore the Torah was strict regarding basar b'chalav only concerning the meat of cattle specifically — in which is the essential hold of the spirit of folly — the aspect of Esav — only that Israel rectify it through shechitah — etc. — as stated. And therefore it requires shechitah of both signs — and its blood does not require covering — and its fat is forbidden — as stated. But the meat of a chayah — in which the light of holy life-force shines more — therefore its fat is permitted — and its blood requires covering. And all the more so fowl — which requires only one sign — therefore there is no biblical prohibition of basar b'chalav with it. But even so it is also rabbinically forbidden. [§3] And therefore holy Torah expressed this prohibition in the language: "you shall not cook a kid in its mother's milk" — even though gedi [kid] includes all cattle. And this is because in the kid there is an extra hold for the aspect of Esav the hairy man. And therefore it is said of Yaakov: "and the skins of the kids of the goats she placed on his hands" — etc. — and it is said afterwards: "and he did not recognize him for his hands were like the hands of Esav his brother — hairy." And see in the holy Zohar what is explained regarding the kids of the goats — and why even so they are permitted for Israel's eating. And therefore the Torah alluded: since in the meat of cattle — the aspect of gedi — there is an extra hold for the aspect of Esav — but Israel rectify it through the mitzvos of shechitah and nikur [removal of forbidden fat and sinews] and salting — therefore: if one cooks it in cattle milk — which was drawn and clarified from its blood — in the aspect of the blood becoming congealed and becoming milk — and it became so clarified of itself through the supernal power coming upon it from above — whose root is from the aspect of supernal whiteness — the aspect of wisdom and thought — through which all holy clarifications — in the aspect of: kulhu b'machshavah isbariru [all are clarified through thought] — and from there the redness of the blood — in which the sitra achra of Esav the red one has seized — was sweetened until it was turned into whiteness — the whiteness of milk — until it became permitted for Israel's eating without any rectification at all. And this is the aspect of: *"and enough milk of goats for your bread — etc. — and life for your maidens"* [Mishlei 27:27] — for it is from the aspect of wisdom and life — as stated. [§4] Therefore: if one cooks in it meat of cattle — in which the sitra achra of Esav has greatly seized — through this one gives it room to overpower even more — G-d forbid. And therefore the Torah was strict specifically in the manner of cooking — for through cooking the flavors of one and the other blend together even more — until they are completely included together and become one — and through this it has the power to suckle and overpower even more. And therefore the cooking itself is also forbidden. And its prohibition is so severe — to the point that it is also forbidden for any benefit — for even the benefit alone that the person receives from it greatly damages his soul — for through this the aspect of Esav — who is forbidden for all benefit — seizes upon him. For all the good of the wicked is evil for the righteous — as understood also regarding Yaakov our father when Esav said to him: "let me place" — etc. And therefore it only applies to the meat of a pure animal in pure milk — where both are permitted. And even meat of neveilah or forbidden fat — even so — at minimum they are of a permitted species. [§5] But if the meat or milk is of an impure species — then there is no prohibition of basar b'chalav regarding cooking and benefit — since it is forbidden anyway from the beginning of its creation — the sitra achra no longer has room to suckle from holiness through this. And therefore: fish and locusts — which require no shechitah at all — are permitted with milk — even rabbinically. But even so — biblically it is only forbidden through the manner of cooking — and specifically meat of cattle in cattle milk. [§6] Even so: our Sages forbade even placing cheese on the table together with meat — even meat of a chayah or fowl — since one may come to eat them together — and give the sitra achra a hold to seize. And not only that — but even if one has already eaten meat — one must not eat cheese afterwards — etc. — as explained in the Shulchan Aruch . For since the sitra achra has some hold in it — one must be concerned also regarding what one eats afterwards — since it draws its flavor even more — or there may remain some between the teeth. But if one ate the cheese first — one need not be concerned about what one eats meat afterwards — provided through rinsing and washing — and see in the Shulchan Aruch . And therefore: basar b'chalav does not apply biblically with the milk of a slaughtered or dead animal. For our Sages taught [Bechoros 6b] — regarding the permission of milk — it is an innovation [ chiddush ] — since it resembles a limb from a living animal yet the Torah permitted it. And therefore one may say: specifically with milk from a living animal — whose permission itself is an innovation — therefore if one cooks meat in it — the sitra achra is aroused to suckle from this — as stated. But not so with the milk of a slaughtered animal — whose permission is not such an innovation. And likewise with milk of a dead animal — which has departed from the prohibition of a limb from a living animal — and even though it is now forbidden because of neveilah — it is in truth forbidden — and the sitra achra has no room to suckle from this. And even according to those who hold that milk of neveilah has no biblical prohibition of neveilah — one may say they hold: even so the prohibition of a limb from a living animal has departed from it — and therefore it is not such an innovation — since it is milk of a dead animal. (And see this matter in the legal authorities.) But even so: even with the milk of a slaughtered animal — it is rabbinically forbidden. And see Siman 30 regarding the law of kechal [udder]. Siman 91 and on — Meat and Cheese that Touched סִימָן צ״א וְכוּ׳

segments.he: אבל אם הבשר או החלב ממין טמא אז אין בו איסור בשר בחלב לענין בישול והנרה מאחר שאסור ממילא מתחלת ברייתו שוב אין מקום להסט"א לינק המקדושה עי"ז. וע"כ דגים וחגבים שאינם צריכין שחיטה כלל מותרין בחלב אפילו מדרגבנן אך אע"פ שמן התורה אינו אסור אלא דרך בישול ודייקא בשר בהמה בחלב בהמה.
segments.en: [§4] And this also is the aspect of a fast on account of a dream — for on a fast day the mind has dominion — as explained in the discourse Sha'alu, Siman 57 — and then the aspect of Esav — Edom — the kingdom of the sitra achra — is subdued — and through this the dream is rectified. And since one must believe and set one's heart to contemplate every hint of wisdom that Hashem alludes to a person each and every day — according to the specific aspect of that day — as stated — one must therefore fast on the day of the dream — specifically on that very day — even on Shabbos — as our Sages taught — for even though eating on Shabbos is very precious and the aspect of Esav has no hold on Shabbos eating — as explained in the discourse Sha'alu mentioned above — nonetheless, since the dream hints to him to fast — presumably there is a wondrous wisdom in this — that he should fast on that day specifically — even if it is Shabbos.

segments.he: אעפ"כ אסרו חז"ל אפילו רק להעלות על השולחן גבינה עם בשר אפילו בשר חיה ועוף כי שמא יבא לאכלם כאחד ויתן מקום להסט"א להתאחז. ולא עוד אלא אפילו אכל כבר בשר לא יאכל גבינה אחריו כוו' כמבואר בשו"ע. כי מאחר שיש בו איזה אחיזה להסט"א ע"כ יש לחוש גם למה שיאכל אחריו מחמת שמושך טעמו ביותר או שמא יהיה נשאר בין שינוי. משא"כ אם אכל הגבינה תחלה אין לחוש למה שיאכל אח"כ בשר ובלבד על ידי קינוח והדחה ועיין בשו"ע. וע,כ אין בשר בחלב נוהג מה"ת בחלב שחוטה או מתה. כי ארז,ל (בכורות דף ו' ע"ב) לענין היתר חלב דחידוש הוא מחמת שדומה לאבר מן החי והתורה התירתו על כן יש לומר שדייקא בחלב מבהמה חיה שהיתירה גופה חידוש הוא ע"כ אם יבשל בשר נתעורר הסט"א לינק מזה כנ"ל. משא,כ בחלב שחוטה שאין בהיתירה חידוש כל כך וכן בחלב מתה שיצאה מאיסור אבר מן החי ואף שאסורה גם עכשיו משום נבלה הלא היא אסורה באמת ואין מקום להסט"א לינק מזה. וגם להסוברים דבחלב נבלה אין בה איסור נבלה מן התורה יש לומר דסבירה להו דאעפ"כ פקע ממנה איסור אבר מן החי ועפ"כ אין בה חידוש כ"כ מאחר שהיא חלב מתה (ועיין בזה בפסוקים) אבל אף על פי כן גם בחלב שחוטה אסור מדרבנן ועיין בסי' ל' מדין כחל

segments.he: סימן צ"א וכו'
segments.en: [§5] The one hundred blessings that King Dovid instituted to recite each day — also [serves] to set the heart upon every thing and bless Him until reaching the count of one hundred blessings — which also allude to the two aspects mentioned above, in the secret of the upper pool and the lower pool — as is understood in the Maurai Or. And this he derived from the verse: *"What does Hashem your G-d ask of you?"* [Devarim 10:12] — "Do not read mah [what] but me'ah [one hundred]" — for mah alludes to the attribute of Malchus — as is known — and specifically through this one receives the light of Chochmah, which is the aspect of Aleph — as it is written: *"and He will teach me wisdom"* [Iyov 33:33].

segments.he: בשר וגבינה שנגעו זה בזה מותרין אלא שצריך להדיח וכו'. כי מאחר שנגעו רק בצונן אין לחוש רק למה שנדבק בעין וסגי בהדחה וכמו כן לענין האדם אם נגע בלבו ומחשבתו איזה דבר שאינו טוב חס ושלו' אם לא היה רק באקראי ולא העמיק בדבר בחמימות היצר רק בבחי' צונן בעלמא די לו בהדחה שיטהר לבו במים טהורים של מימי התורה והשכל דקדושה. אבל לכתחל' בודאי צריך לשמור עצמו גם מבחינה כזאת דילמא אכיל ליה בלא הדחה שמא לא ישים אל לבו תיכף לכבס ולטהר את לבו מכל מניי פסולת הנדבק בו אף בצונן ונמצא שתהיה עבודתו מעורבת עם הפסולת ח"ו. וכ"ז בצונן אבל ברותח אפי' אם רק החלב רותח ונפל לתוכו בשר צונן וכו' הכל אסור דתתאה גבר וכו' כי התחתון מחמם העליון או מקררו כפי מה שהוא התחתון אם רותח או צונן. כי הכל תלוי בתחתונים כי באמתערותא דלתתא איתער לעילא. וכן לענינינו החכמה והשכל היא בחינת מדרגה העליונה בחי' ראש וראשית וכתיב אורח חיים למעלה למשכיל וכו' ובחי' מלכות הוא בחי' מדרגה התחתונה כי היא בחי' סוף דבר ועל כן נאמר בה זאת ירושלים שמתיה בתוך הגוים וכו' וע"כ שם עיקר המלחמה וכמובן גם בפנים וע,כ הכל תלוי כפי בחי' התתאה אם היא רותח שזה בחי' שהתגברו בו רתיחת הדינים אזי אף אם התחתון הוא היתר ונפתל לתוכו איסור צונן נאסר כולו. ואם התחתון צונן אף שהוא איסר ונפל לתוכו היתר רותח ואוסר אם הטמא מליח. כי מלח רומז לבחי' השכל כמבואר לעיל בחלק או"ח ועל כן אם הטמא מליח ומתלבש עצמו באיזה בחי' שכל על כן אסור גם ההיתר.
segments.en: [§1] Meat and cheese that touched each other are permitted — but one must wash — etc. — for since they touched only while cold — one need only be concerned about what adhered visibly — and washing suffices. And likewise regarding the person: if something not good — G-d forbid — merely touched his heart and thought — if it was only incidentally — and he did not deepen it in the warmth of the inclination — but only in a cold manner — it suffices for him to wash — to purify his heart with the pure waters of Torah and holy intellect. But initially one certainly must guard oneself even from such an aspect — lest one eat it without washing — perhaps one will not immediately place one's heart to wash and purify one's heart from all the dross that adheres to it even while cold — and one's service will be found mixed with dross — G-d forbid.

segments.he: ועיין בשו"ע הפרטים בזה. וזה בחינת ביטול האיסור בששים. כי כל תערובות איסור בהיתר הוא בחינת פגם בבחי' המלכות דקדושה שהיא בחי' נו"ן. וארז"ל שלכך לא נאמ נו"ן באשרי מפני שיש בה מפלה וכו' ואפילו הכי חזר דוד וסמכה ברוה"ק שנאמר סומך ה' לכל הנופלים. וע,כ אם יש ששים בהיתר זה מרמז על החיזוק וסמיכה שיש לבחי' הקדושה ע"י בחי' הסמ"ך שזה בחי' ששים המה מלכות ועיין במאמ' היכל הקדש סי' נ"ט.
segments.en: [§3] And see in the Shulchan Aruch the particulars therein. And this is the aspect of nullification of the prohibition in sixty . For all mixture of a prohibition in something permitted is the aspect of damage to holy Malchus — the aspect of nun . And our Sages taught: why is the letter nun not written in Ashrei — because it contains a falling — etc. — and even so David returned and supported it through the holy spirit — as it is said: "Hashem supports all the fallen" [Tehillim 145:14]. And therefore: if there are sixty times the amount of permitted — this alludes to the strengthening and support that holiness has — through the aspect of the samech [60] — the aspect of: "sixty are the queens" [Shir HaShirim 6:8]. And see in the discourse Heichal HaKodesh , Siman 59.

segments.he: וע"כ לא אמרינן חתיכה נעשה נבלה אלא בבשר בחלב שהוא כגופו של איסור שהוא מבחי' הסט"א בחי' נבלה היפוך בחי'לבנה דקדושה אבל אם בלעה החתיכה משאר איסורים לא אמרינן חנ"נ מן התורה לכולי עלמא כי מאחר שגוף החתיכה הוא היתר שהוא מצד הקדושה אלא שנתערב באיסור וע,כ היא אז בבחי' נפילה ונאסרת אבל אעפ"כ יש לה תקוה עדיין לקום מנפילתה ע"י בחי' הסמ"ך היינו כשיתוסף עליה היתר עד שמתבטל האיסור בששים בבחי' סומך ה' לכל הנופלים. וע,כ אין מבטלין איסור לכתחלה רק שיתוסף ההיתר ממילא בלא כוונה לבטל. כי זה בחי' מה שדרז"ל נפלה ולא תוסיף עוד לקום מעצמה כי אם שהקב"ה בעצמו כביכול יקום אותה בבחי' אקום את סוכת דוד וכמו כן לענין זה כשמתכוונין להוסיף היתר לבטל האיסור הוא כאלו כביכול בחי' הקדושה שהיא בחי' כנסת ישראל קמה מעצמה לבטל האיסור. אבל כשנתוסף ממילא זה סיעתא דשמיא בההשגחת השי"ת בבחי' סומך ה' (בעצמו כביכול) לכל הנופלים להקים אותם בבחי' אקום את סוכת דוד כנ"ל הגם שעיקר השלימות היא דווקא ע"י אתערותא דלתתא כידוע היינו שעל ידי אתערותא דלתתא שלנו יתעורר השי"ת מעצמו כביכול להקים אותנו (ואין כאן מקום לבאר יותר בזה)
segments.en: [§4] And therefore: we do not say chaticha na'asis neveilah [the piece becomes like a carcass] except regarding basar b'chalav — which is the body of the prohibition itself — and is from the aspect of the sitra achra — the aspect of neveilah — the opposite of the holy moon. But if the piece absorbed from other prohibitions — we do not say chaticha na'asis neveilah biblically — by all opinions. For since the body of the piece is permitted — it is from the side of holiness — only that it became mixed with the prohibition — and therefore it is now in the aspect of falling and becomes forbidden. But even so: it still has hope to rise from its fall — through the aspect of the samech — meaning: when permitted is added upon it until the prohibition becomes nullified in sixty — the aspect of: "Hashem supports all the fallen." And therefore one does not nullify a prohibition initially — only when permitted is added automatically without the intention to nullify. For this is the aspect of what our Sages taught: "it has fallen and shall not rise again by itself" — but rather the Holy One, blessed be He, Himself will raise it — as it were — the aspect of: "I will raise up the fallen Tabernacle of David" [Amos 9:11]. And likewise regarding this: when one intends to add permitted to nullify the prohibition — it is as if — as it were — the aspect of holiness — the aspect of Knesses Yisrael — rises by itself to nullify the prohibition. But when it is added automatically — this is heavenly assistance — the providence of Hashem — the aspect of: "Hashem supports" — (Himself as it were) — "all the fallen" — to raise them — the aspect of "I will raise up the fallen Tabernacle of David" — as stated. Even though the essential fullness is specifically through arousal from below — as is known — meaning: through our arousal from below — Hashem Himself is aroused — as it were — to raise us. (And there is no room to elaborate further here.) Siman 98 and on — Laws of Mixtures סִימָן צ״ח וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת תַּעֲרֻבוֹת [§1] The laws of mixtures. And therefore specifically in a different species — where the taste of the prohibition is recognizable and perceived — sixty is needed to nullify it. For then presumably the taste of the prohibition is already nullified and no longer perceived. And therefore: anything whose taste matters — even in a thousand it is not nullified — since the taste of the prohibition is still perceived. And the matter of taste in every thing — it flows at its root from the aspect of intellect and daas — as cited above in Orach Chaim. And therefore: as long as the taste of the prohibition — which is from the aspect of the sitra achra — is still perceived — it is forbidden. But if the prohibition is from the Torah — through the majority — since the majority is from the side of holiness — therefore the prohibition is nullified through the majority — for biblically we follow the majority. And therefore a person is judged according to his majority — and so the world — as our Sages taught. But even so rabbinically — sixty is needed even in the same species in liquid with liquid. [§2] And therefore: prohibited matters also combine to nullify one another — if they are different in taste — as explained in Siman 98, paragraph 9. To indicate: the sitra achra is not an independent authority — G-d forbid — but they too receive life-force from Him — as elaborated in his teachings in many places. And therefore: when Hashem wants to subdue the sitra achra — sometimes He subdues it from itself — mineih uveih ava lizol beih narga [from it and by it the axe goes into it] — as we find: the fall of Vashti through Haman — and the completion of Haman's fall through Charvonah. And similarly many more. And this touches somewhat also on what our Sages taught: "great is a transgression performed for its own sake" — etc. — for even though the transgression itself is certainly from the aspect of the sitra achra — even so: when one's intention is truly for the sake of Heaven — sometimes the sitra achra is subdued through this specifically. But because of the great danger — one must certainly be extremely careful about such a thing. And likewise: sometimes one must use the quality of anger and cruelty to take vengeance against the wicked — and many more similar things. And it is self-evident in general from this: when Hashem wants to strengthen the power of holiness — He sometimes brings it support and reinforcement from the other side — in the aspect of: "and the evil angel is forced to say amen." And this is the aspect of what Haman's wise men and Zeresh his wife themselves told him: "if he is of the seed of the Jews — etc. — you shall surely fall before him." And likewise: Achashveirosh himself commanded that Haman be killed — and removed his ring from his hand — and gave it to Mordechai. Siman 100 and on — Beryah ; Things That Have No Nullification סִימָן ק׳ וְכוּ׳ [§1] And therefore: a beryah [whole creature] is not nullified — etc. — and it has the law of beryah only if it had life-force in it and was forbidden from the beginning of its creation. For since it was forbidden from the beginning of its creation — and never had a permitted moment — and it had life-force — from this it is self-evident that both it and its life-force are from the aspect of the sitra achra . And therefore — because of its power and importance — our Sages taught: it cannot be reversed to become permitted and move to the side of holiness — and even in a thousand it is not nullified. For every time one encounters the prohibition and eats it — one damages one's soul through it — since it was rooted in the aspect of the life-force of the sitra achra — which is the essential sitra d'mosa — the aspect of: "in their lives they are called dead" — as is known.

segments.he: סימן צ"ח וכו'
segments.en: [§1] For meriting all of the above comes through engaging in Torah — and this: "please make the words of Your Torah sweet in our mouths" — for as it is already said: *"the righteous walk in them, but sinners stumble through them"* [Hoshea 14:10] — and our Sages taught: "If one merits, it becomes for him a life-giving potion — for he merits through this to receive the light of Chochmah, which is the aspect of life."

segments.he: הלכות תערובות, וע,כ דייקא באינו מינו שניכר ונרגש טועם האיסו' על כן צריכין סמ"ך דייקא לבטלו כי אז מסתמא כבר בטל טעם האיסור ואינו נרגש. ועל כן באמת מילתא דעבידי לטעמי אפילו באלף לא בטל מאחר שנרגש טעם האיסור. וענין הטעם שיש בכל דבר נמשך בשרשו מבחי' שכל ודעת כמובא לעיל בחלק או"ח. וע"כ כל זמן שנרגש טעם האיסור שהוא מבחי' הטס"א על כן אסור אבל אם האיסור הוא מן התורה ברוב. כי מאחר שהראוב הוא מצד הקדושה ע"כ בטל האיסור ברוב כי מן התורה אזלינן בתר רובא. וע, כ האדם נידון אחר רובו וכן העולם כשארז"ל. אך אעפ"כ מדרבנן צריכין סמ"ך גם במין במינו בלח בלח. וע"כ איסורין מצטרפין ג"כ לבטל זה את זה אם משונים בטעמם כמבואר בסי' צ"ח סעי' ט'. להורות כי גם הסט"א אינה רשות בפני עצמה ח"ו רק גם הם מקבלין חיות ממנו ית' כמבואר מזה בדבריו ז"ל בכמה מקומות. וע"כ כשהשי"ת רוצה להכניע הסט"א לפעמים הוא מכניע אותה מינה ובה בעצמה בבחי' מיניה וביה אבא ליזול ביה נרגא וכעין שמצינו במפלת ושתי ע,י המן וגמר מפלת המן על ידי שמצינו במפלת ושתי ע"י המן וגמר מפלת המן על ידי חרבונא ועוד כיוצא באלה וזה ניגע קצת גם למה שארז"ל גדולה עבירה לשמה וכו' כי אף שהעבירה עצמה בוודאי היא מבחי' הסט"א אעפ"כ כשכוונתו באמת לשמה אזי לפעמים מכניעין הסט"א עי"ז דייקא. אך מחמת גודל הסכנה צריכין בוודאי ליזהר בנפשו מאד מענין כזה. וכן צריכןי להשתמש לפעמים במדת הכעס ואכזריות לעשות נקמה ברשיעם ועוד כיוצא בזה הרבה. ומובן ממילא בכלל זה בכל איסורין מבטלין זה את זה שכהשי"ת רוצה להגביר כח הקדושה אזי מביא לה סיוע וחיזוק לפעמים מבחינת הצד השני בבחינת ומלאך רע בע"כ יענה אמן. וזה בחי' מה שאמרו לו להמן חכמיו וזרש אשתו בעצמם אם מזרע היהודים וכו' כי נפול תפול לפניו. וכן אחשורוש בעצמו צוה להרוג את המן והסיר את טבעתו מעל ידו ויתנה למרדכי:
segments.en:
[§3]
And even though it is also written regarding holiness: "and with the modest ones is wisdom" [Mishlei 11:2] — and: "and to walk humbly" [Michah 6:8] — etc. — the difference is self-evident. For this is only in the way of modesty — and concealing one's good deeds — so that all his deeds be entirely for the sake of Heaven — without any other intent whatsoever. It emerges that one does not conceal oneself out of shame — G-d forbid — but on the contrary — as stated. But the incitement of the yetzer hara is only in the aspect of theft and chaladah and hiddenness — because the deeds themselves contain great shame even in the eyes of other people. And also in general: holiness and all these rectifications are in the aspect of light and revelation — while the sitra achra is the aspect of darkness and gloom — the aspect of: "the fool walks in darkness" [Koheles 2:14] — and it is written: "and their deeds shall be in the dark" [Yeshayahu 29:15] — and many other similar verses — the aspect of concealment and chaladah and darkness — as stated.

[§4]
And therefore: legally chaladah invalidates only if it is attached to the thing being slaughtered — which indicates the darkness and hiddenness that exists in the body of the matter itself — because of a flaw and shame that it contains. But if the shechitah became covered and hidden through another object — such as a cloth spread over the animal's neck — and one slaughtered it — the shechitah is valid — for sometimes even in holiness there is such an aspect — as stated. And some invalidate even this — for since the sitra achra mimics holiness like a monkey before a man — and sometimes dresses itself in mitzvos — therefore in the time of the battle of shechitah one must be concerned and careful even in this. And also: sometimes the yetzer hara prevents a person from performing a mitzvah — and sometimes brings him to actual transgression — G-d forbid — through this very act of dressing in the mitzvah of: walk humbly — to conceal one's actions from other people to such a degree that it brings him to complete stumbling — G-d forbid — as cited in the holy books. Therefore a person must examine his ways carefully and be careful also from such chaladah — as stated. And the matter of hagramah [cutting above the proper place] is somewhat explained above.

segments.he: סימן קוף וכו'
segments.en: [§2] If one did not merit — meaning when he follows his evil inclination, G-d forbid — then not only does he not subdue it through Torah study, but on the contrary, at times it grows stronger against him through the cunning that enters him — until he finds a justification for his wickedness from the Torah itself, G-d forbid — as is known — and then it becomes for him a death-dealing potion — for the words of Torah, when they enter his mouth, are so degraded and coarsened that they become the aspect of bitterness — like the waters of Marah — *"and they could not drink the waters of Marah — for they were bitter"* [Shemos 15:23] — meaning, the waters themselves were bitter and repugnant. And like the gravely ill person whose every bite turns to wormwood and bitterness in his mouth.

segments.he: וע,כ בריה אינה בטילה וכו' ואין לה דין בריה אא"כ היה בו חיות ואסור מתחלת ברייתו. כי מאחר שאסור מתחלת ברייתו ולא היה לו שעת הכושר מעולם והיה בו חיות וממילא מובן כי הוא והחיות שלו מבחי' הסט"א ע"כ מחמת כחו וחשיבותו ארז,ל שאינו יכול להתהפך להיתר ולצד הקדושה ואפילו באלף לא בטיל. כי כל אימת שיפגע בהאיסור ויאכלנו יפגום את נפשו עי"ז מאחר שהיה נשרש בבחי' החיות דסט"א אשר היא עיקר סטרא דמותא בחי' בחייהם קרוים מתים כידוע. וכמו כן חתיכה הראויה להתכבד מאחר שהיא בבחי' חשיבות וכבוד בחי' מלכות וחן דסט"א ע"כ גם אינה בטילה. וכן דבר שיש לו מתירין אינו בטל במין במינו. כי עד שתאכלנו באיסור תאכלנו בהיתר. וע,כ אם יאכלנו בזמן איסורו אפילו ע"י ביטול נראה כאלו יש לו רצון ונטיה לצד האיסור מאחר שדבר זה עצמו יכול לאכלו בהיתר:
segments.en: [§1] And therefore: a beryah [whole creature] is not nullified — etc. — and it has the law of beryah only if it had life-force in it and was forbidden from the beginning of its creation. For since it was forbidden from the beginning of its creation — and never had a permitted moment — and it had life-force — from this it is self-evident that both it and its life-force are from the aspect of the sitra achra . And therefore — because of its power and importance — our Sages taught: it cannot be reversed to become permitted and move to the side of holiness — and even in a thousand it is not nullified. For every time one encounters the prohibition and eats it — one damages one's soul through it — since it was rooted in the aspect of the life-force of the sitra achra — which is the essential sitra d'mosa — the aspect of: "in their lives they are called dead" — as is known. [§2] And likewise: a piece that is worthy of being honored — since it is in the aspect of importance and honor — the aspect of Malchus and grace of the sitra achra — therefore it too is not nullified. And likewise: something that has a way to become permitted is not nullified in the same species . For until one eats it in the state of prohibition — one could eat it in the permitted state. And therefore: if one eats it in the time of its prohibition — even through nullification — one appears as if one has will and inclination toward the side of prohibition — since this very thing could be eaten in the permitted state. Siman 103 and on — Spoiled Taste; Hot and Cold סִימָן ק״ג וְכוּ׳ [§1] And therefore: anything whose taste is spoiled does not forbid its mixture . For since one derives no benefit from the taste of the prohibition — but on the contrary — therefore it is not considered a taste at all and cannot forbid the permitted. And therefore: a vessel that is not a ben yomo [used within the last 24 hours] is considered a spoiled taste . For since the taste of the prohibition is not visible — only absorbed and covered and hidden within the vessel — and since a full cycle of day and night has passed over it — which encompasses the aspect of day and night — sun and moon — the taste of the prohibition has already become spoiled and weakened — and it no longer has the power to forbid the permitted. And therefore: if the permitted is a sharp thing — we say: it makes it desirable again. For through the power of sharpness — whose root is from the aspect of judgments — the aspect of what our Sages taught about the school of Shammai: that they were sharper — through this the power of the taste of the prohibition is aroused and strengthened — whose root is from the aspect of the extension of judgments. And some say: overnight weakens the prohibition — the aspect of bas dina batel dina [when the judgment has passed — the judgment is nullified]. And therefore our Sages taught: soaked is like cooked . For since it was soaked within the prohibition — or the prohibition within it — for a full cycle of day and night — even though it is cold — since the prohibition is visibly present and pressed into something liquid for a full cycle which encompasses the aspects of sun and moon — therefore through the power of the aspects of sun and moon of the sitra achra — the taste of the prohibition is absorbed within it — as through cooking. And the matter of tata'ah gabar and maliyach k'rosei'ach [salted is like boiled] is somewhat explained above. Siman 108 — Scent ( Rei'ach ) סִימָן ק״ח [§1] And therefore: we say rei'ach [scent] is of no consequence after the fact — for the essential hold of the sitra achra and foolishness is only from the side of physicality and corporeality. But through scent — which is something spiritual — there is no power to forbid — unless one of them is a sharp thing — for then the prohibition has the power to overpower through the aspect of sharpness — as stated. Siman 109 — Fixed [ Kavua ]; Doubt סִימָן ק״ט

segments.he: סימן ק"ג וכו'
segments.en: [§3] And therefore one prays that one merit for the words of Torah to be sweet and pleasant in one's mouth — and this: "Maharev na" [please make sweet] — specifically — for erev has the sense of aravit [evening] and the withdrawal of light — and also the sense of sweetness and pleasantness — in the aspect of *"and the light is sweet"* [Koheles 11:7]. For through Torah study one merits both these aspects — to the degree that even the contraction — the aspect of Malchus, the attribute of night — is also in the aspect of light — for specifically through it one merits the sweetness of the light of the intellect — as stated.

segments.he: וע"כ כל דבר שטעמו פגום אינו אוסר תערובתו. כי מאחר שאינו נהנה מטעמו של איסור רק אדר בא. ע"כ אינו חשוב טעם כלל ואינו יכול לאסור את ההיתר. וע"כ כלי שאינה בת יומא חשיבא טעם לפגם. כי מאחר שטעם האיסור אינו בעין רק בלוע ומכוסה ונעלם בתוך הכלי ומאחר שעבר עליו מעת לעת שלם שכולל בחי' יום ולילה חמה ולבנה כבר נפגם ונחלש טועם האיסור ואין לו כח לאסור עוד את ההיתר. וע"כ אם ההיתר דבר חריף אמרינן משוי ליה לשבח. כי ע"י כח החריפות ששרשו מבחי' דינים שזה בחי' מה שארז"ל על ב"ש דהוי חריפי טפי. עי"ז נתעורר ונתחזק כח טעם האיסור ששרשו מבחי' השתלשלות הדינים. וע,כ יש אומרים שלינת לילה פוגמת שזה בחי' בת דינא בטל דינא. וע"כ ארז,ל כבוש הרי הוא כמבושל. כי מאחר שנשרה בתוך האיסור או האיסור בתוכו מעת לעת שלם אזי אע"פ שהוא צונן מאחר שהאיסור בעין ונכבש בדבר לח מעת לעת שכולל בחי' חמה ולבנה ע"כ בכח בחי' חמה ולבנה דסט"א נבלע בתוכו טעם האיסור כמ וע"י בישול. וענין תתאה גבר וענין מליח כרותח מבואר כבר קצת:
segments.en:
[§6]
And ikur [uprooting a sign] invalidates — such as when one sign was uprooted from the jaw and flesh where its root of connection is — then the shechitah of the other sign too does not help. For the rectification of shechitah does not avail unless both signs are connected and affixed to their root. But not if one was completely separated from its root and connection before the completion of shechitah — and this is somewhat understood according to the above.

segments.he: סימן ק"ח
segments.en: [§4] And this: "and may we and our children" — etc. — "know Your Name" — that we merit to know His Name with full knowledge and great understanding. And this: "who study Your Torah for its own sake."

segments.he: וע,כ אמרינן ריחא לאו מילתא לענין דיעבד כי עיקר אחיזת הסט"א והכסילות הוא רק מצד הגשמיות והגופניות. אבל ע"י ריח שהוא דבר רוחני אין כח לאסור אם לא שאחד מהם הוא דבר חריף שאז יש כח להאיסור להתגבר ע"י בחי' החריפות כנ"ל:
segments.en: [§1] And therefore: we say rei'ach [scent] is of no consequence after the fact — for the essential hold of the sitra achra and foolishness is only from the side of physicality and corporeality. But through scent — which is something spiritual — there is no power to forbid — unless one of them is a sharp thing — for then the prohibition has the power to overpower through the aspect of sharpness — as stated. Siman 109 — Fixed [ Kavua ]; Doubt סִימָן ק״ט [§1] And it is already somewhat explained: regarding the same species — it is nullified only through a majority — not counting things of importance and the like — as stated. And therefore: anything fixed [ kavua ] is considered as half and half . For since the prohibition and the permitted are each fixed in its own place — the concept of majority-nullification does not apply — unless one of them separated from its fixed place — then we say: "all that separates — separates from the majority." And therefore: all doubtful prohibitions are forbidden . For the essential deception of the sitra achra and the yetzer hara is through the aspect of doubts — for it is impossible for it to completely reverse a person's mind from one extreme to the other — and make something forbidden seem permitted — G-d forbid — only through the aspect of doubts — casting some aspect of doubt in the matter — and afterwards inciting one further — until it brings one to actual transgression — G-d forbid. And therefore our Sages were more stringent regarding a doubtful prohibition than a certain one at times — for the chatat [sin-offering] is one danka — and the asham talui [contingent guilt-offering] is two sela'im — (see Rabbeinu Yonah at the beginning of tractate Berachos). But even so: a doubt of a doubt [ sfek sfeka ] is permitted — for since there is yet another doubt inclining toward permitted — therefore according to some opinions it is like a majority — and even according to those who say it is somewhat less than a majority — even so we lean more toward permitted — for the hand of holiness is on top — the aspect of: "and great in kindness — He tilts toward kindness." And therefore: even in two pots — we say the prohibition fell into the prohibition — and the permitted into the permitted. [§2] And see Siman 111. Siman 112 and on — Foods of Non-Jews סִימָן קי״ב וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת מַאֲכַלֵי עַכּוּ״ם

segments.he: סימן ק"ט
segments.en: [§5] And this: "Who teaches Torah to His people Israel" — the Melamayd — specifically — for in every matter and affair that Hashem brings about with us at every time, clothed in every thing, is a great and holy understanding that guides us to draw close to Him and cleave to Him — and this is the essential definition of studying the holy Torah — as it is written: *"and you shall show them the path in which to walk"* [Shemos 18:20].

segments.he: וכו') וכבר מבואר קצת מענין מה שמין במינו בטל ברוב לבד מדברים חשובים וכיוצא כנ"ל. וע"כ כל קבוע כמחצה על מחצה דמי. כי מאחר שהאיסור וההיתר כל אחד קבגוע במקומו לא שייך בו ביול ברוב היתר אא"כ פירש אחד ממקום קביעותו אז מארינן כל דפריש מרובא פריש. וע"כ כל ספק איסור אסור. כי עיקר הטעאת הסט,א והיצה"ר הוא ע"י בחי' ספיקות כי א"א לו להפוך דעת האדם לגמרי מהיפוך אל היפוך ולעשות לו מאיסור היתר ח"ו רק ע,י בחי' הספיקות שמטיל לו איזה בחי' ספק בדבר ואח"כ מסיתו עוד עד שמביאו לידי עבירה ח"ו. וע"כ ארז"ל שהחמירו על ספק איסור יותר מעל ודאי לפעמים כי החטאת הוא בדנקא ואשם תלוי בשני סלעים (עיין ברבינו יונה בריש מסכת ברכות). אך אעפ"כ ספק ספיקא מותר כי מאחר שיש עוד ספק שנוטה להיתר ע"כ הוא ליש אומרים כמו רובא ואף להאומרים דגרע מרובא קצת אעפ"כ תלינן יותר להיתר כי יד הקדושה על העליונה בבחי' ורב חסד מטה כלפי חסד. וע"כ גם בשתי קדירות תלינן לומר איסור לתוך איסור נפל והיתר לתוך היתר.
segments.en:
סִימָן כ״ה וְכוּ׳

[§1]
And therefore one must examine after a chayah [wild animal] whether the majority of the signs were slaughtered — and if one did not examine afterwards — it is forbidden — for a living animal is presumed forbidden until one knows it was slaughtered properly. For the holy sparks or the soul reincarnated in the animal — the aspect of those sitting in darkness and gloom — prisoners of affliction and iron [Tehillim 107:10]. For it was bound and imprisoned in the spirit of animality — the aspect of the spirit of folly and foolishness and darkness — which is from the aspect of Esav — as our Sages taught: "and to darkness He called night — this is Esav." And it hopes to be rectified and to ascend through the rectifications of shechitah. But typically the impediments from the side of the sitra achra grow very strong to prevent its rectification. Therefore it is in the presumption of being forbidden — while regarding the animal itself — from now it is in the presumption of being permitted — since it is of a pure species. Therefore: if afterwards some defect occurred in it — one treats it as presumed permitted — as explained in the Shulchan Aruch.

segments.he: ועיין סימן קי"א:
segments.en: [§6] And this: "Who chose us from all peoples and gave us His Torah" — for through the holy Torah He separated us from the nations, who are from the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — the side of the yetzer hara — and through the holiness of the Torah we are rescued from them and subdue them.

segments.he: סימן קי"ב וכו'
segments.en: [§7] The Priestly Blessing — adjacent to this: "May Hashem bless you and protect you" — corresponding to the aspect of Malchus — which is the aspect of Shamar [guarding] — and there [in Malchus] is the command: *"for there Hashem commanded the blessing — life"* [Tehillim 133:3] — the opposite of the kingdom of the sitra achra — the side of Esav, of whom it is said: "and he did not desire blessing." And Yaakov our father, through having merited the birthright — the aspect of the bond with the intellect mentioned above — therefore also received the blessing. And our Sages taught: "May He bless you with wealth" — which is from the aspect of Malchus — and *"the rich man rules over the poor"* [Mishlei 22:7] — "and protect you from the destroyers" — which are from the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — the four primary damages — and our Sages also taught: "and protect you from the yetzer hara" — for it is the aspect of the yetzer hara — as stated.

segments.he: הלכות מאכלי עכו"ם. וע,כ יש כמה דברים שאסרו רז"ל משום חתנות כגון פת של עכו"ם ובישולי עכו"ם ושכר ומשקים שלהם וכו'. כי מאחר שעיקר אחיזת הסטו"א היא בהגשמיות של האדם באכילה ושתיה ע"כ צריך להרחיק עצמם מאד ממאכלם ומשתם כי עי"ז יכול להלכד במצודותיהם ולהתפתות אחריהם עד שיבא לחתנות עמהם ח"ו וזה שנקטו רז"ל לשון חתנות. לרמז כי פוגמים עי"ז ביותר בבחי' היחוד הקדוש שבין בחי' חמה ולבנה דקדושה שעי"ז נעשה אותיות נחת בחי' דברי חכמים בנחת נשמעים המרפ"נ. וזה ג"כ אותיות חתן. וזה בחי' והוא כחתן יוצא וכו' שנאמר על החמה.
segments.en: [§1] The laws of foods of non-Jews. And therefore there are several things our Sages forbade on account of the risk of intermarriage — such as the bread of non-Jews — and foods cooked by non-Jews — and their beer and beverages — etc. For since the essential hold of the sitra achra is in the physicality of the person — in eating and drinking — one must distance greatly from their food and drink — for through this one can be caught in their traps and be enticed after them — until one comes to intermarriage with them — G-d forbid. And this is why our Sages used the language: on account of intermarriage . To allude: for through this one damages most greatly the holy union between the aspects of sun and moon of holiness — through which is made the letters of nachas — the aspect of: "the words of the wise are heard in gentleness" — as explained within. And this is also the letters of chasan [groom]. And this is the aspect of: *"and he is as a groom going out"* [Tehillim 19:6] — which is said of the sun. [§2] And when one damages this — through which one gives strength to the sitra achra — G-d forbid — this becomes the aspect of intermarriage of the sitra achra — G-d forbid. And therefore: if there was some force and assistance in it from a Jew — such as through stoking and a toothpick — the sitra achra can no longer overpower as much — and it is permitted.

segments.he: וכשפוגמים בזה שעי"ז נותנים כח להסט"א ח"ו נעשה מזה בחי' חתנות דסט"א ר"ל. וע,כ אם היה בזה איזה כח וסיוע ע,י ישראל כגון ע"י חיתוי וקיסם שוב אין כח לסט"א להתגבר כ"כ ומותר:
segments.en: [§2] And when one damages this — through which one gives strength to the sitra achra — G-d forbid — this becomes the aspect of intermarriage of the sitra achra — G-d forbid. And therefore: if there was some force and assistance in it from a Jew — such as through stoking and a toothpick — the sitra achra can no longer overpower as much — and it is permitted.

segments.he: סימן קט"ו
segments.en: [§8] "May Hashem cause His countenance to shine upon you" — the aspect of the illumination of the holy wisdom and intellect — which is the essence of life and the light of the face — as stated — as it is written: *"in the light of the king's countenance is life"* [Mishlei 16:15]. And this: "and be gracious to you" — the aspect of chen — as stated. "May Hashem lift His countenance toward you" — our Sages taught: "at the time when you stand in prayer" — etc. — meaning that through this all prayers and requests are accepted. And "and grant you peace" — meaning one will no longer be burdened by any battle against the yetzer hara — the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — only peace and tranquility on every side, and the entire sitra achra will be fully subjugated to holiness.

segments.he: וע,כ חלב שחלבו עכו"ם ואין ישראל רואהו אסור שמא עירב בו חלב טמא. וכן גבינות העכו"ם אסורה מפני שמעמידים אותה בעור קיבת נבלה וכו'. כי הכלל שצריכין ליזהר מכל מניי מאכל שלהם. כי ע"פ רוב יש בה מאחיזת הסט"א כנ"ל. וזהו שאמרו חלב טהור נקפא ועומד וחלב טמא אינו נקפא ועומד. כי בחינת הקדושה בבחינת אחדות והתחברות ויש בה בחינת בירור אוכל מתוך אוכל או מתוך פסולת כמו בירור הגבינה והחמאה ממימי החלב. משא"כ בחי' הטומאה היא בבחי' פירוד בחי' יתפרדו כל פועלי און והכל מעורב ביחד עם הפסולת מאחר שכולה היא בחי' פסולת גמור בחי' כל שלחנם מלא קיא צואה בחי' צא תאמר לו
segments.en: [§3] And therefore: milk milked by a non-Jew without a Jew watching is forbidden — lest he mixed impure milk into it. And likewise: cheese of non-Jews is forbidden — since they curdle it with the rennet of neveilah — etc. For the general rule: one must guard oneself from all their foods — for most of the time there is in them the hold of the sitra achra — as stated. And this is what they said: pure milk curdles and stands firm — and impure milk does not curdle and stand firm . For the aspect of holiness is in the aspect of unity and connection — and in it there is the aspect of clarifying food from food — or from dross — like the clarification of cheese and butter from the whey of the milk. But the aspect of impurity is in the aspect of separation — the aspect of: "then all evildoers shall be scattered" — and everything is mixed together with the dross — since all of it is the aspect of complete dross — the aspect of: "all their tables are full of vomit and excrement — tell it to go away." Siman 116 — Foods that Carry Risk סִימָן קט״ז [§1] And therefore one must guard against eating anything with a concern of danger. For eating and the like must be from the side of holy wisdom — the aspect of life — and not from something with a concern of danger — the aspect of Esav — who said: "behold I am going to die" [Bereishis 25:32] — for he was always in a place of danger from wild animals — etc. — as the commentators explained. And therefore: it is also forbidden to eat something repulsive — etc. — for it is from the aspect of the hold of the sitra achra — which is disgusting and repulsive — as stated — the opposite of holy — which is in the aspect of grace and importance — as explained within. Siman 117 — Commerce in Forbidden Foods סִימָן קי״ז

segments.he: סימן קט"ז
segments.en: [§9] These are the things that have no limit — for this deep learning has no limit whatsoever — for one must engage in this always, all the days of one's life, and go from level to level, meriting at every turn the aspect of a renewed acceptance of the Heavenly yoke, new contractions, and the illumination of the intellect anew at an ever higher and greater level — in the aspect of *"the path of life leads upward for the wise"* [Mishlei 15:24] — as is known. And therefore these things — which allude to this matter — have no limit whatsoever.

segments.he: וע,כ צריכין ליזהר מלאכול דבר שיש בו חשש סכנה. כי האכילה וכיוצא צריכה להיות מצד החכמה דקדושה שהיא בחי' חיים ולא מדבר שיש בו חשש סכנה בחי' עשו שאמר הנה אנכי הולך למות כי היה תמיד במקום סכנה מחיות רעות וכיוצא כמ ושפירשו המפרשים ז"ל. ועל כן אסור ג"כ לאכול דבר מאוס וכו'. כי היא מבחי' אחיזת הסט,א שהוא משוקץ ונמאס כנ"ל היפוך מנבחינת הקדושה שהיא בבחינת חן וחשיבות כמבפ"נ
segments.en: [§1] And therefore one must guard against eating anything with a concern of danger. For eating and the like must be from the side of holy wisdom — the aspect of life — and not from something with a concern of danger — the aspect of Esav — who said: "behold I am going to die" [Bereishis 25:32] — for he was always in a place of danger from wild animals — etc. — as the commentators explained. And therefore: it is also forbidden to eat something repulsive — etc. — for it is from the aspect of the hold of the sitra achra — which is disgusting and repulsive — as stated — the opposite of holy — which is in the aspect of grace and importance — as explained within. Siman 117 — Commerce in Forbidden Foods סִימָן קי״ז [§1] And therefore: it is forbidden to engage in commerce in things forbidden for eating — unless they came to one automatically — etc. — for the matter of trade — in all buying and selling — is through the aspect of intellect and wisdom. And therefore: the sale of a deaf-mute or a minor is nothing.

segments.he: סימן קי"ז
segments.en: [§10] Pe'ah [the corner of the field] alludes to the aspect of Malchus and contraction — as is known. Bikkurim [first fruits] alludes to the aspect of the illumination of the intellect and wisdom — which is the aspect of bechorah [firstness / the birthright] — the aspect of reishis [beginning / primacy] — as is explained within. Re'ayon [the appearance at the Temple] — the aspect of gazing — that one must gaze only at the intellect in every thing — this being the aspect of the mitzvah of appearing [at the Temple] on the pilgrimage festivals to receive the light of the Divine countenance — as is understood in the discourse Mishra, Siman 30.

segments.he: וע,כ אסור לעשות סחורה בדברים האסורים באכילה אא"כ נזדמנו לו ממילא וכו'. כי ענין המסחר בכל מקח וממכר הוא על ידי בחי' שכל וכחמה. ועל כן מכירת שוטה וקטן אינו כלום.
segments.en: [§1] And therefore: it is forbidden to engage in commerce in things forbidden for eating — unless they came to one automatically — etc. — for the matter of trade — in all buying and selling — is through the aspect of intellect and wisdom. And therefore: the sale of a deaf-mute or a minor is nothing.

segments.he: וארז"ל הרוצה שיתחכם יעסוק בדיני ממונות. ועל כן אסור לסחור ולהשתמש בשכלו וחכמתו בענין זה בדברים האסורים שהם מבחי' הסט"א אא"כ נזדמנו לו ממילא בתוך ביתו בתוך דברים המותרים. כגון בציד שנזדמנו לו דברים טמאים אבל תחלת מחשבתו לא היתה דוקא לכך. וכן אם נזדמנה לו נבלה וטרפה בביתו מותר למכרה כי כל זה נעשה בלי הכנת מחשבתו לכך וכן לגבות דברים טמאים בחיבו מן העכו"ם הוא ג"כ ע"פ ההכרח כי הוא כמציל מידם והוה כנזדמנו
segments.en: [§2] And our Sages taught: "one who wishes to grow wise should engage in laws of monetary matters." And therefore: it is forbidden to trade and use one's intellect and wisdom in this matter — in forbidden things — which are from the aspect of the sitra achra — unless they came to one automatically within one's home — within permitted things. Such as in hunting — where impure things came to one alongside. But one's initial thought was not specifically for this. And likewise: if a neveilah or treifah happened to be found in one's home — one is permitted to sell it — for all of this was done without preparing one's mind for it. And likewise: collecting impure things as a debt from a non-Jew — is also out of necessity — for it is like saving from their hands — and it is considered as if it came to one automatically. Siman 118 and on — Depositing or Sending with a Non-Jew סִימָן קי״ח וְכוּ׳

segments.he: סימן קי"ח וכו'
segments.en: [§11] Gemillas chasodim [acts of lovingkindness] and Talmud Torah — for one must give strength to the yetzer tov — the aspect of the holy Malchus — to overpower the yetzer hara — the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — and this one merits through Torah study — as is explained within. And gemillas chasodim is also needed — in order to sweeten the dinim [judgments] and gevuros [stern powers] from which the nourishment of Esav — the kingdom of the sitra achra — the yetzer hara — draws. And this is what our Sages expounded [Avodah Zarah 5b]: "Happy are you who sow over all waters, sending forth the feet of ox and donkey" — when Israel engages in Torah and acts of lovingkindness, their inclination is given into their hands — as stated.

segments.he: וע"כ אם מפקיד או שולח ביד עכו"ם או חשוד דבר שיש בו חשש איסור דאורייתא אם יחליף צריכין חותם בתוך חותם כנגד בחינת התיקונים הנ"ל. כי המוחין והחמכה הם בחי'חותם בחי' תפלין מוחין שהם בחי' חותם כידוע וכן המלכו תהוא בחי' חותם כמו שדרז"ל (ב"ר פרשה וישב) חותמך ופתילך חותמך זה מלכות וכו' עיין שם:
segments.en: [§1] And therefore: if one deposits or sends with a non-Jew — or a suspect — something with a biblical concern of prohibition — lest he exchange it — one needs a seal within a seal — corresponding to the aspect of these rectifications. For the mochin and wisdom are the aspect of a seal — the aspect of tefillin — the aspect of mochin — which are in the aspect of a seal — as is known. And likewise: Malchus is the aspect of a seal — as our Sages taught [Bereishis Rabbah, Parshas Vayeshev]: "your seal and your cord — your seal is Malchus" — etc. — see there. Siman 120 — Immersion of Vessels סִימָן ק״כ

segments.he: סימן ק"כ
segments.en: [§12] "These are things from whose fruits a person eats in this world while the principal remains intact for the World to Come" — etc. — for our Sages already taught that Yaakov took as his portion the World to Come; and the reward of the World to Come — it is known that the essential reward is the light of attainment and wisdom — to perceive Him in perfect knowledge — and this is the essential occupation of Yaakov even in this world — for "today is the time to act" — and "according to how much a person cleaves in this world" — etc. However, for the time being, while a person is still clothed in a body, he also needs the body's necessities — which are from the side of this world — and his intention in them is only for the sake of the purpose of the World to Come. But for the time being he is also in need of them — and therefore [the Sages] taught: "these are things from which a person eats the fruit also in this world" — but the principal remains complete for him for the World to Come — which is the essential thing for the Jewish person.

segments.he: וע,כ כלי סעודה של עכו"ם של מתכות צריכין טבילה. כי גוף המאכל והסעודה שעל ידה חיות האדם היא בבחי' חכמה והכלי שאוכלין בה היא בבחינת מלכות. וע,כ כלי סעודה אפילו חדשים מאחר שהיו ברשות עכו"ם והיו מוכנים לסעודת עכו"ם שורה עליהם רוח הטומאה מבחינת מלכות דסט"א ששרשה מבחינת סוספיתא דדהבא בחינת השתלשלות הגבורות שהם בחי' אש שזה בחי' כלי מתכות שנעשה ע"י שניתך באש. וע"כ כשנכנסת לרשות ישראל צריכה טבילה במים ששרשם מבחי' חסדים בחי' חכמה בחינת תורה שע"י כל זה נמתקין הגבורות בשרשם ונתבטל בחינת הרוח שטות רוח הטומאה ועולה הכלי מטומאה לטהרה. ועל כן אם שאל או שכרכלי מן העכו"ם אז אין צריך טבילה, כי עדיין רשות בעליו עליו וגם כי אז אינו מתגבר כ"כ מאחר שלא יצא עדיין מרשות עכו"ם ועתיד לחזור לשם. משא"כ כשיצא מרשות עכו"ם לרשות ישראל אז מתגבר ביותר לינק מבחי' הקדושה ועל כן צריך טבילה
segments.en: [§1] And therefore: eating vessels of non-Jews made of metal require immersion . For the body of the food and the meal — through which is man's life-force — is in the aspect of wisdom. And the vessel in which one eats is in the aspect of Malchus. And therefore: eating vessels — even new ones — since they were in the possession of non-Jews and were prepared for the meals of non-Jews — the spirit of impurity — from the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — rests upon them. And the root of this is from the aspect of sospisa d'dahava [the dross of gold] — the aspect of the extension of gevuros — which are the aspect of fire — the aspect of metal vessels that are made through being melted in fire. And therefore: when one brings them into the possession of Israel — they require immersion in water — whose root is from the aspect of chasadim — the aspect of wisdom — the aspect of Torah. And through all of this the gevuros are sweetened at their root — and the aspect of the spirit of folly — spirit of impurity — is nullified — and the vessel rises from impurity to purity. [§2] And therefore: if one borrowed or rented a vessel from a non-Jew — immersion is not required. For it is still under the owner's authority — and also: it does not overpower as much — since it has not yet left the possession of the non-Jew — and is destined to return there. But when it leaves the possession of the non-Jew to the possession of Israel — then it overpowers more to suckle from the holiness — and therefore immersion is required. [§3] And therefore: old vessels of non-Jews — immersion is not sufficient — but as was their use — so must they be kashered. In the aspect of: *"all that comes into fire — pass it through fire"* [Bamidbar 31:23] . For since the vessel absorbed from the forbidden food itself — which is from the aspect of the sitra achra — therefore: if it absorbed through fire — it specifically requires libun [burning out] through fire. And if it absorbed through boiling water — it requires hag'alah [boiling out]. And if it absorbed while cold — washing and rinsing suffices. And this has been somewhat explained in Orach Chaim. And the matter of nosen ta'am lifgam [gives a spoiled taste] — and a vessel that is not a ben yomo — is somewhat explained above. Siman 123 and on — Wine of Non-Jews סִימָן קכ״ג וְכוּ׳ [§1] And therefore: the prohibition of drinking the wine of non-Jews is very severe — and even through their mere touch it becomes forbidden . For since in holiness its root is very lofty — and encompasses all the aspects of these rectifications. For it is from the aspect of wisdom and mochin — the aspect of: "wine and fragrance open the mind" — and the aspect of Torah — and the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of: "and the wine of the kingdom was abundant" [Esther 1:7] — etc. — as understood in the discourse Tehillah L'Dovid , Siman 12 — and likewise in the holy Zohar. And this is the aspect of: "he who merits — becomes a head." And therefore one must truly be very careful in its drinking — not to exceed the measure — G-d forbid — for intoxicating wine is the aspect of the very opposite of all the above. And therefore: it becomes forbidden through the touch of a non-Jew — and damages the soul of the Jew who drinks it — and the yetzer hara overpowers him even more — until one can come through this to all evil — G-d forbid. And this is the aspect of: "and concerning their wine — on account of their daughters." And see in the book Yayin HaMeshomar [The Preserved Wine] — which elaborated greatly on the severity of the prohibition — and you will understand from there for our subject. And according to the above you will understand how to explain many verses and teachings of our Sages that speak of wine in praise — or the opposite — and all of it is understood according to the above. Siman 139 and on — Laws of Idolatry סִימָן קל״ט וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה

segments.he: סימן קכ"א וכו'
segments.en: [§13] Returning to the matter of the Blessing over Torah: one who merely thinks about Torah words is not required to recite the blessing — for the essential Torah study through which one gives strength to holy Malchus and merits to receive the light of Chochmah — the essential life — all of this is accomplished through Torah study in full voice — specifically — for Malchus is the mouth. And this is what our Sages taught: "for they are life to those who find them" — "to those who bring them forth through the mouth" — specifically. And therefore according to some opinions, one who listens to words of Torah must also recite the blessing — since his fellow at least brings it forth through the mouth.

segments.he: וע"כ כלים ישינים של עכו"ם אין די להם בטבילה, רק כתשמישם כך הכשירם.
segments.en:
סִימָן ל׳ וְכוּ׳

[§1]
Now — to explain all types of treifos in detail according to this approach would require great length — and also because the hidden matters are not our domain — to explain the secret of every single aspect and organ of a living creature — and what they allude to spiritually at their root — one must therefore be brief in this. And regarding the law of the cut windpipe — through its majority — and the perforated esophagus — in the smallest amount — this has been somewhat explained above. And were it not for my concern — I would say in a playful manner regarding the matter explained in the Shulchan Aruch, Siman 33: that the outer layer of the esophagus is red and the inner layer is white — etc. — for it is already explained that the windpipe alludes to the aspect of Yaakov — who chose the World to Come — in which there is no eating and drinking — which is the aspect of the windpipe. And this is the aspect of: "the voice is the voice of Yaakov" — the aspect of the windpipe which produces voice — and it is also in the aspect of: "acquire wisdom" [Mishlei 4:5] — which is the attribute of Yaakov. And Esav's hold is in the aspect of the esophagus — where the essential eating and drinking passes — etc. — as all of this is understood in the holy Zohar.

[§2]
And behold: Yaakov and Esav were both in one womb — and even at their birth it is said: "and his hand grasped the heel of Esav" — for the windpipe and the esophagus are by nature joined together in Creation. And therefore: if the esophagus separated from the windpipe — etc. — it is a treifah. For this is Yaakov's quality — not to separate the esophagus — which is the aspect of this world in which there is eating and drinking — from the World to Come — the aspect of the windpipe. For Yaakov too had to use the things of this world — only he did everything with wisdom — and all his deeds were for the sake of Heaven. Not so Esav — who corrupts the order of Creation and separates the aspect of this world from the World to Come entirely — which is the aspect of the esophagus being separated from the windpipe — and therefore it is a treifah — the aspect of the sitra d'mosa.

[§3]
And this is the aspect of: the esophagus — which alludes to the aspect of this world — has two skins. The outer one is red — for in it the aspect of Esav the red one seizes most. And the inner one is white — for the inner dimension of this world is in the aspect of whiteness and brightness — the aspect of the World to Come — the aspect of the thirty-two paths [of wisdom] — whose acronym is lavan [white] — as is known. And therefore: if they were reversed — so that the outer is white and the inner is red — this is from the aspect of Esav — whose inner dimension is from the fierce power of judgment and the lusts of this world — and even when he performs something of holiness — which is the aspect of whiteness — the aspect of chasadim — the aspect of the World to Come — it is only in the aspect of externality — while his inner dimension is the aspect of Esav who is red. Therefore it is a treifah. And likewise if both are red. And if both are white — see in the Shulchan Aruch.

[§4]
And according to the opinion that forbids even this — it is a treifah — for this is the aspect of: *"do not be overly righteous"* [Koheles 7:16] — the aspect of Esav's questions: "how does one tithe straw?" — etc. One may also say: the esophagus — which is the aspect of this world — has in it the hold of Esav and Yishmael. Esav is red — and Yishmael is in the aspect of white — for they also count by the moon — and his suckling is from the side of kindness — the aspect of whiteness — from the side of Avraham. And therefore he is in the aspect of white milk — as stated. And therefore: when Yaakov went to Lavan — to subdue his klippa and clarify from him the holy sparks — as stated in Orach Chaim — then Esav went to Yishmael — etc. — in order to receive even more power from him — and to unite with him against Yaakov. And therefore: if they were reversed — this indicates the cunning of the yetzer hara — the aspect of Esav — dressing itself in mitzvos — which are the aspect of whiteness — but its inner intention is to do harm. And likewise if both are red or white — this indicates that the klippos of Esav and Yishmael united together to overpower Yaakov — and therefore it is a treifah. And likewise: if it has two esophagi or two windpipes — it is a treifah — for: "everything extra is as if removed." And it goes without saying regarding two esophagi — for in it is the essential hold of wicked Esav: "do not be overly wicked" — but even two windpipes — it is also a treifah — the aspect of: "do not be overly righteous." And also: "and do not be overly wise" [Koheles 7:16] — for one's deeds must be more than one's wisdom.

[§5]
And therefore: the essential fullness of acquiring wisdom and the World to Come is through acquiring holy Torah — which is the aspect of the central pillar — as stated. All of this we have written in a somewhat playful manner — as stated. And in truth it is difficult to explain all matters of treifos in detail — for they are numerous. But in general: there are organs that are the vessels of life-force.

[§6]
Such as the brain, the heart, and the lung — and within them too there are details: the skull and the membranes of the brain and the brain itself — and likewise the pericardium and the cardiac muscle and the cardiac chambers and the cardiac tube — and likewise the membranes of the lung and the lung tissue and the bronchial tubes. And there are the vessels of eating — the digestion of food — its purification and clarification — which are the intestines and the proventriculus and the crop and the stomach — etc. — and the liver and the gall bladder and the spleen — etc. — and likewise all of them.

[§7]
And likewise there are vessels of the general structure of the body — such as the spine and the ribs. And vessels of the body's functioning — for standing and walking and lying and resting. And within each of these categories there are many particulars — as stated. And all of them allude spiritually to what they allude to — and everything is encompassed within the aspect of drawing these rectifications — which is the general of all. For Chochmah and intellect is the aspect of the totality of the first three [Keter, Chochmah, Binah]. Torah is the aspect of the central pillar — the aspect of the Vav of the extremities. And Malchus is the aspect of the sof davar [end of the matter] — as is known. And therefore our Sages received the halachic measure of all types of treifos of each and every organ as a law given to Moshe at Sinai — according to its aspect. For there are blemishes that relate essentially to the aspect of drawing Chochmah and intellect — the aspect of life-force. And there are blemishes that flow from having damaged against holy Torah — and the essential is through the sin of neglecting Torah — G-d forbid. And there are blemishes that flow from having damaged the aspect of Malchus. And in all of them our Sages received the true measure — in what manner the blemish can still be rectified easily — and then the treifah that descended through it does not entirely destroy the life-force of the creature — G-d forbid — but it can be healed — and over time it returns to health. And there are those where the blemishes prevailed so greatly — to the point that they affect the life-force — and it does not survive twelve months — as our Sages taught: "a treifah does not survive." And then it is forbidden — for the sitra achra has seized it — and will trap one's soul through this eating — G-d forbid.

[§8]
And therefore: if there is a doubt whether a treifah survived twelve months — or until it became pregnant and gave birth — it is in the presumption of being valid. For from this it is apparent and seen that the sitra d'mosa does not have hold upon it — for: "one who has no support does not produce fruit." And since it became pregnant and gave birth — it is apparent that it is from the side of holiness — which is the aspect of eternal life — the aspect of the world's sustenance through species. And it is in the aspect of what our Sages taught regarding a person — that one who leaves a son behind — etc. — is as if he did not die. And therefore it is said: "pure fat closes the hole" — for it is as the flesh itself — and therefore it naturally adheres to it well and closes. But impure fat — since it is from the aspect of the white of the sitra achra — as stated — it does not adhere as well to the flesh and does not close. And therefore: whatever in cattle corresponds to this is not closing in the chayah either — for it suffices to free itself by what the Torah permitted from the species of chayah — as stated — but not to close and save the creature from treifah — since it too does not naturally adhere to the flesh. But even so the Torah permitted it — as stated.

segments.he: בבחי' כל דבר אשר יבא באש תעבירו באש כי מאחר שבלע מנוף מאכל האסור בעצמו שהוא מבחי' הסט"א ע"כ אם בלע ע"י אש צריך ליבון באש דייקא ואם בלע בחמין צריך הגעלה ואם בצונן די לו בשטיפה והדחה וכבר מבואר קצת מזה בחלק או"ח וענין נותן טעם לפגם וכלי שאינה בן יומא מבואר קצת לעיל
segments.en: [§1] For it is explained within that even in a place of darkness and gloom the intellect illuminates for [a person] — etc. — and this is the aspect of the evening Shema. For one must draw the power of Torah and holy intellect and the acceptance of the Heavenly yoke of Kingship — also at night.

segments.he: סימן קכ"ג וכו'
segments.en: [§14] The prayer Ribon Kol HaOlamim — for "from where shall wisdom be found?" [Iyov 28:12] — and likewise holy Malchus is in the aspect of poor and destitute — only receiving from the aspect of Chochmah — the opposite of the kingdom of the sitra achra, which rules arrogantly without a crown — and is therefore called melech zakein u'ksil [an old and foolish king] — for all arrogance is foolishness. And our Sages taught: if one is wise, his wisdom departs from him. And therefore, immediately in the morning one should arise early and say "Ribon kol ha'olamim" — etc. — to nullify and humble oneself before the holy Malchus and holy Chochmah in complete self-nullification.

segments.he: וע,כ חמור מאד איסור שתיית יינם של עכו"ם ואפילו במגעם לבד נאסר. כי מחמת שבקדושה הוא בשרשו גבוה מאד וכלול מכל בחי' התיקונים הנ"ל. כי הוא מבחינת חכמה ומוחין בחינת חמרא וריחא פיקחין ובבחי' תירה ובבח'י מלכות בחינת ויין מלכות רב וכו' וכמובן במאמר תהלה לדוד סימן י"ב וכן בזוה,ק וזה בחי'זכה נעשה ראש. וע"כ באמת צריכןי ליזהר בשתייתו מאד שלא להיות יותר מהמדה ח"ו כי יין המשכר הוא בחי' ההיפוך מכל הנ"ל. וע,כ נאסר במגע העכו"ם ופוגם בנפש ישראל השותה אותו ומתגבר עליו היצה"ר. ביותר עד שיוכל לבוא עי"ז לכל רע ח"ו. וזה בחינת ועל יינם משום בנותיהם ועיין בספר יין המשומר שהאריך הרבה בחומר האיסור ותבין משם לענינינו. וע,פ הנ"ל תבין לפרש כמה פסוקים ומאמרי רז"ל שמדברים בענין שתיית היין לשבח או להיפוך והכל מובן ע"פ הנ"ל

And this is the aspect of: "he who merits — becomes a head." And therefore one must truly be very careful in its drinking — not to exceed the measure — G-d forbid — for intoxicating wine is the aspect of the very opposite of all the above. And therefore: it becomes forbidden through the touch of a non-Jew — and damages the soul of the Jew who drinks it — and the yetzer hara overpowers him even more — until one can come through this to all evil — G-d forbid. And this is the aspect of: "and concerning their wine — on account of their daughters." And see in the book Yayin HaMeshomar [The Preserved Wine] — which elaborated greatly on the severity of the prohibition — and you will understand from there for our subject. segments.he: סימן קל"ט וכו'
segments.en: [§15] And this: "What are we, what is our life?" — etc. — "and the advantage of man over beast is nothing — for all is vanity" — for even the wisdom and intellect of a person, if it is not fully bound to holiness, G-d forbid — that too is vanity. And this: "but for the pure soul" — etc. — which is a portion of G-d Above — as it is written: *"and He breathed into his nostrils a living soul"* — and one who breathes, breathes from within himself — and she is the source of holy intellect — as stated — and she will in the future render account — etc. — for every movement that was not completely and perfectly bound to the holy intellect as it should have been.

segments.he: הלכות עבודה זרה. כי עיקר שורש כל הע"ז הוא מהיצר הרע שהוא בעצמו בחי' ע"ז כ"ש לא יהיה בך אל זר וכמו שדרז"ל וכן ארז,ל כך דרכו וכו' היום אומר לו וכו' ולמחר אומר לו לך עבוד ע"ז והוא עיקר הטומאה בחי' ההיפוך ממש מבחי' הקדושה כי הוא עיקר הסט,א והוא בחינת קיא צואה ממש כי אין שם כלל מבחינת הארת השכל דקדושה בבחינת וכבודי לאחר לא אתן וכמבואר במ"א וע"כ נקראים אלילים כי הם בחי' כלא ממש וכלאו כלום היפוך מבחי' החכמה דקדושה שהיא בחי' יש מאין כידוע. וע"כ אסורה הע"ז בהנאה כי כל הנאות האדם וקורת רוחו הוא בחי' ניצוץ מבחי' חלקי החיות שלו אבל ע"ז שהיא עיקר סטרא דמותא אסור לישראל לקבל ממנה שום הנאה ואיזה בחי' חיות כלל כי חיות כזה מר ממות ר"ל. וזה בחי' אסורה בהנאה היא ותשמישיה ונויה ותקרובתה. תשמישיה הם כנגד בחי' מלכות דסט"א. כי בזה שמשמש לפניה שזה בחי' עבד המשמש לרבו מראה בזה שמקבל עול מלכותה. ונויה הוא כנגד בחינת השכל דסט"א כי עיקר הנוי והיופי בשרשה הוא מבחי' החכמה שהיא בחי' אור בחי' חכמת אדם תאיר פניו.
segments.en: [§1] The laws of idolatry. For the essential root of all idolatry is from the yetzer hara — which is itself the aspect of idolatry — as it is written: "there shall not be in you a strange god" [Tehillim 81:10] — and our Sages taught accordingly. And our Sages taught: "such is its way — today it says to him: do such — etc. — and tomorrow it says: go worship idolatry." And this is the essential impurity — the very opposite of holiness. For this is the essential sitra achra — and it is the aspect of vomit and excrement — for there is no aspect at all of the illumination of holy intellect in it — the aspect of: "My glory I shall not give to another" [Yeshayahu 42:8] — as explained elsewhere. And therefore they are called elilim [nothings] — for they are the aspect of absolute nothing — as if they never existed — the opposite of holy Chochmah — the aspect of yesh me'ayin [something from nothing] — as is known. And therefore idolatry is forbidden for any benefit — for all of a person's pleasure and his spirit's satisfaction is an aspect of a spark from the aspects of the portions of his life-force. But idolatry — which is the essential sitra d'mosa — it is forbidden for Israel to receive from it any benefit or any aspect of life-force whatsoever — for such a life-force is more bitter than death — G-d forbid. [§2] And this is the aspect of: it is forbidden for benefit — along with its accessories and its adornments and its offerings. Its accessories correspond to the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — for through serving before it — the aspect of a servant serving his master — one thereby shows that one is accepting the yoke of its kingdom. Its adornments correspond to the aspect of the intellect of the sitra achra — for the essential beauty and splendor at its root is from the aspect of Chochmah — the aspect of light — the aspect of: "a man's wisdom illuminates his face." [§3] And its offerings correspond to the aspect of the union of sun and moon of the sitra achra together — G-d forbid — and as they say: k'din metashteshei alma [it causes confusion in the world] — G-d forbid. For the sitra achra is like a monkey before a man. And in holiness — the offering is in the aspect of the drawing close of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah — as understood in the holy Zohar. And: "the scattering of the wicked is good for them and good for the world" — for they are in the aspect of separation — as is known. And therefore their offering is a great damage — G-d forbid — for it indicates the connection and union — G-d forbid — between them. [§4] And therefore: idolatry of non-Jews is forbidden immediately — for they are from its aspect. But that of Israel is not forbidden until it is actually worshipped. For in truth — at the root of his holiness — he is utterly distant from it. But if one has already worshipped it — then on the contrary — since it is Israel's — it receives some additional power through this — since he is Israel whose root is in holiness. And therefore: idolatry of Israel has no nullification — but requires complete eradication and burning. But that of a non-Jew has nullification — for it has no such power — since all the nations themselves are as absolute nothing — as our Sages taught. And therefore: as soon as the non-Jew nullifies the idolatry — the prohibition departs from it. But its offerings have no nullification — for the power and aspect of the prohibition and the sitra achra has greatly cleaved there — because of the greatness of the damage of the aspect of the connection mentioned — for they are addicted to this most — as is known. And therefore: its accessories and adornments — even though nullification helps them — even so they are forbidden for use in a mitzvah — because they are repulsive.

segments.he: ותקרובתה הוא כנגד בחי' חיבור חמה ולבנה דסט"א ביחד ר"ל וכדין מטשטשי עלמא ר"ל. כי הסט"א הוא כקוף בפני אדם. ובקדושה (להבדיל) הקרבן הוא בבחי' קריבו דקוב"ה ושכינתיה כמובן בזוה,ק ופיזור לרשעים הנאה להם והנאה לעולם כי הם בבחי' פירוד כידוע. וע,כ הקרבן שלהם הוא פגם גדול ח"ו כי מורה על החיבור והיחוד ח,ו ביניהם. וע,כ ע"ז של עכו"ם אסורה מיד, כי הם מבחינתה. אבל של ישראל אינה אסורה עד שתיעבד. כי באמת בשורש קדושתו הוא רחוק ממנה לגמרי אבל אם כבר עבדו אותה אזי אדרבא מחמת שהיא של ישראל מקבלת עי"זאיזהבחי' כח ביותר מחמת שהוא של ישראל ששרשו בקדושה ע"כ ע"ז של ישראל אןי לה ביטול רק שצריכין לבער ולשרוף אותה לגמרי. אבל של עכו"ם יש לה ביטול כי אין לה כח כ"כ כי גם כל העכו"ם בעצמם הם כאין וכלא ממש וכמו שארז"ל וע"כ תיכף שמבטל העכו"ם את הע"ז בטל האיסור ממנה. אבל תקרובתה אין לה ביטול כי דבק שם כח בחי' האיסור והסט"א ביותר מחמת גודל פגם בחי' החיבור הנ"ל כי הם להוטים אחר זה ביותר כידוע. וע"F תשמישיה ונויה אע"פ שמועיל להם ביטול אעפ"כ אסורין לדבר מצוה משום דמאיסה.
segments.en:
סִימָן מ״ז — בִּרְכוֹת הַתּוֹרָה

 
 [§1]
 For meriting all of the above comes through engaging in Torah — 
 and this: "please make the words of Your Torah sweet in our mouths" — 
 for as it is already said: 
 *"the righteous walk in them, but sinners stumble through them"* [Hoshea 14:10] — 
 and our Sages taught: 
 "If one merits, it becomes for him a life-giving potion — 
 for he merits through this to receive the light of Chochmah, which is the aspect of life."
 

 
 [§2]
